items.title: Compelling Local Service Sales Page
items.description:
High-Converting Local Service Landing Page

I’m looking for an experienced conversion copywriter/web designer to create a single-page, conversion-focused landing page for a local waxing and skincare business.

The business specializes in Brazilian waxing, body waxing, facials, vagacials, and advanced skincare treatments.

The primary goal is to turn online visitors into booked appointments, especially first-time Brazilian waxing clients who may be nervous, unsure, comparing providers, or concerned about pain, embarrassment, or ingrown hairs.

This needs to be a sales tool—not simply a pretty webpage.

Target Customer

Our primary audience is women who may be:

* Getting their first Brazilian wax
* Nervous about pain
* Embarrassed or uncomfortable
* Worried about being judged
* Dealing with razor bumps or ingrown hairs
* Frustrated with inconsistent waxing
* Tired of switching waxers
* Looking for a more personalized experience than a chain
* Looking for an experienced professional who understands both waxing and skin

The messaging should feel professional, comfortable, knowledgeable, judgment-free, and approachable.

The tone should feel like an experienced esthetician calmly guiding someone through the process—not a salesperson pushing a booking.

Core Positioning

A key positioning concept is being known as a “First-Time Wax Specialist.”

This does not mean the business only serves first-time clients. It means we understand that many clients are nervous because they don’t know what to expect.

The desired reaction is:

“Okay. I feel like I can actually do this.”

Brand positioning:

Approachable expertise + personalized care + professional results.

Primary Goal

BOOK AN APPOINTMENT

Use strategically placed CTAs throughout the page.

Possible CTA language:

* Book Your Appointment
* Book Your Brazilian
* Ready When You Are — Book Now
* Start Your Waxing Journey
* Book Your First Brazilian

Please recommend the strongest CTA based on conversion strategy.

Required Section 1: Local Service Area

The page must clearly communicate that this is a local business serving a defined geographic area.

The actual city/service area will be provided privately to the selected freelancer.

SEO should naturally target terms such as:

* Brazilian wax [City] [State]
* Brazilian waxing [City]
* Waxing [City] [State]
* Body waxing [City] [State]
* Esthetician [City] [State]
* Facials [City] [State]

Include a section such as:

Serving [City] & Nearby Communities

A map, location cue, or other local trust signal may be recommended.

Required Section 2: Reviews & Trust

Trust is especially important because Brazilian waxing is an intimate service.

Create a prominent testimonial/review section using authentic client reviews that I will provide.

Testimonials may highlight:

* First-time experiences
* Feeling comfortable
* Pain/anxiety concerns
* Professionalism
* Cleanliness
* Results
* Ingrown/razor-bump concerns
* Personalized service
* Returning consistently

Possible trust signals include review ratings, review counts, credentials, cleanliness cues, and local-business credibility.

Never fabricate testimonials, ratings, credentials, awards, or statistics.

Required Section 3: Services & Pricing

Pricing must be transparent and easy to find.

Primary service:

Brazilian Wax — $65 regular price

A current promotional/new-client offer may also be incorporated.

Additional services may include:

* Body Waxing
* Vagacial
* Facials
* Skin Treatments
* Advanced skincare

Do not overwhelm the visitor with every service. Brazilian waxing should remain the primary conversion path, with skincare as a secondary opportunity.

Please recommend the best service hierarchy.

Messaging Strategy

The copy should address objections instead of simply listing services.

For example:

“Nervous about your first Brazilian? You don’t have to know exactly what to do. We’ll walk you through the experience so you know what to expect before we begin.”

Address questions such as:

* Will it hurt?
* What if I’ve never been waxed?
* What if I’m embarrassed?
* What if I get ingrowns?
* How long should my hair be?
* What should I do before my appointment?
* What happens during the appointment?
* What should I expect afterward?
* How often should I wax?
* How much does it cost?
* Where are you located?
* How do I book?

The goal is to remove uncertainty before asking for the booking.

Recommended Page Structure

1. Hero — Clear positioning, benefit-driven headline, location cue, primary CTA.
2. Why Choose Us — Expertise, personalized service, comfort, skin-conscious waxing, first-time guidance.
3. Problem → Solution — Address anxiety, pain, embarrassment, ingrowns, and previous bad experiences.
4. What to Expect — Simple process:
    Book → Arrive → Wax → Aftercare
5. Services + Pricing — Easy-to-scan pricing and CTA.
6. Reviews — Prominent authentic testimonials.
7. Service Area — Local SEO and geographic information.
8. FAQ — Focus on first-time questions and booking objections.
9. Final CTA — Strong close with an unmistakable booking button.

Possible headline:

Your Brazilian Doesn’t Have to Be Intimidating.

Possible final headline:

Ready to Stop Shaving and Start Waxing With Confidence?

SEO

Primary keyword:

Brazilian Wax [City] [State]

Secondary keywords can include:

Brazilian waxing [City], Waxing [City] [State], Body waxing [City] [State], Waxing near [City], Esthetician [City] [State], Facials [City] [State].

Use keywords naturally in headings, body copy, FAQs, services, and the location section.

The page should sound like a premium local beauty business—not an SEO article.

Visual Direction

The brand is:

Modern • Minimal • Warm • Elevated • Approachable • Clean

Think editorial beauty brand, not traditional day spa.

Preferred:

* Warm neutrals
* Cream/off-white
* Charcoal
* Soft earth tones
* Subtle greenery
* Clean typography
* Generous white space
* Editorial photography
* Minimal clutter

Avoid excessive pink, cheesy stock photos, generic spa imagery, overly feminine design, heavy gold/luxury styling, busy layouts, and aggressive sales graphics.

Mobile-First

The page must work well on mobile, tablet, and desktop.

A significant amount of traffic will come from social media.

Mobile priority:

Service → Location → Trust → Price → CTA

Buttons must be obvious and easy to tap.

The wireframe should demonstrate both desktop and mobile flow.

Conversion Strategy

I want someone who understands CRO and customer psychology, not just copywriting.

Consider:

* Pain points
* Objection handling
* Social proof
* Authority
* Risk reduction
* Offer presentation
* CTA placement
* Visual hierarchy
* Mobile conversion
* Local SEO
* First-time customer anxiety

The visitor should never wonder:

“What do I do next?”

Deliverables

1. Sales Page Copy

Google Doc or Word document containing:

* H1/H2s
* Complete copy
* Service descriptions
* Pricing
* Testimonial placement
* FAQ
* CTA/button copy
* Micro-copy
* SEO recommendations
* Developer notes

2. Wireframe/Mockup

Figma, Canva, PDF, or similar.

Show section order, headlines, copy blocks, CTAs, testimonials, pricing, service area, FAQ, images, trust signals, and mobile layout.

This does not need to be a fully designed website. It should be a clear blueprint a developer can build.

3. One Revision Round

One revision round after delivery focused on tightening messaging, improving flow, rearranging sections, clarifying offers, adjusting CTAs, and addressing objections.

Acceptance Criteria

✓ Clearly communicates what the business does and who it serves
✓ Local service area is obvious
✓ Brazilian waxing is the primary conversion path
✓ Pricing is easy to find
✓ Authentic testimonials are prominent
✓ First-time/nervous concerns are addressed
✓ Expertise is communicated without intimidation
✓ Clear path from discovery → trust → offer → booking
✓ Strong CTAs
✓ SEO-friendly without keyword stuffing
✓ Mobile and desktop friendly
✓ Developer-ready copy and wireframe
✓ Feels distinctive, professional, and premium—not generic

Ideal Freelancer

Experience with local service businesses, beauty/wellness, waxing, esthetics, salons, appointment-based businesses, local SEO, landing pages, conversion copywriting, CRO, and customer psychology is preferred.

When applying, please provide:

1. 2–3 examples of high-converting local service landing pages.
2. A brief explanation of what made them effective.
3. Your recommended approach for this project.
4. Fixed project price.
5. Estimated turnaround.

Final Note

I’m looking for someone who can think strategically, not simply rearrange information into a pretty webpage.

The question behind every section should be:

“Does this help the visitor feel confident enough to book?”

I want this page to become one of the business’s strongest customer-acquisition assets—a 24/7 salesperson.

If you understand local SEO, conversion psychology, persuasive copy, and the unique hesitation involved with intimate services like Brazilian waxing, I’d love to see your work.

items.title: Dairy Factory Pasteurization Line Engineer
items.description:
I need an Engineer in Food/Industry/Agricultural 
It is a project work

The Story: Pasteurization Line Problem

Setting: A mid-sized dairy factory runs a plate heat exchanger (PHE) to pasteurize milk using the HTST method (High Temperature Short Time — typically 72°C for 15 seconds).

1. Observed

During peak production hours, operators notice the outlet milk temperature from the heat exchanger occasionally dips below the required 72°C setpoint. The automatic diversion valve keeps kicking in, sending under-processed milk back for reprocessing — wasting time and energy.

2. Analysed

The engineer investigates:
-Measure the flow rate
-Calculated the required heat capacity
-Determined the performance of plate heat capacity
-Evaluated the relationship between flow rate, temperature difference, Pressure drop
-Check the residence time

After the investigation, Analysed → Calculated → Compared → Decided → Implemented → Verified

3. Calculated

Turn the raw data into numbers you can act on:

Required heat duty: Q = ṁ·Cp·(T_out − T_in) using current flow and target temperature.
Actual/available heat duty: based on the PHE's heat transfer coefficient (U), surface area (A), and the log-mean temperature difference (LMTD) between hot and cold streams — Q = U·A·ΔT_lm.
Residence time: Volume ÷ flow rate, checked against the 15-second HTST minimum.
Pressure drop trend: how ΔP changes with flow rate and with time since last cleaning (fouling indicator).

This tells you where the shortfall is — e.g. "at 1500 L/h, required duty exceeds available duty by X kW" or "residence time drops below 15 sec above 1400 L/h."

4. Compared

Lay out multiple operating scenarios side by side (like the table from before) — different flow rates, pressure drops, and resulting pasteurization temperatures — and compare each against:

The regulatory/food-safety requirement (72°C for 15 sec, or your local dairy code equivalent)
Energy cost implications of each option
Throughput/production implications of each option

5. Decided

Pick one course of action, with justified reasoning — not just "reduce flow rate" but why that option, over the alternatives, given the trade-offs found in the comparison. Common decision paths:

Reduce/cap flow rate during peak hours
Increase CIP (cleaning) frequency to control fouling
Adjust hot-water/steam supply temperature or flow to increase available heat duty
Some combination of the above

6. Implemented

Describe the actual change made: new setpoint, new cleaning schedule, updated SCADA alarm thresholds, staff briefing, etc.

7. Verified

Monitor the same parameters (outlet temp, pressure drop, diversion valve activations) over a follow-up period (days/weeks) to confirm the fix worked, and document the before/after comparison.

items.title: Improve IoT App Performance & Backend Transition
items.description:
I already have an IoT mobile app with its backend up and running; however, the user experience suffers from noticeable latency. My goal is to polish the codebase, trim anything that consumes resources unnecessarily, and move the entire stack from Google Firebase to a VPS that uses MQTT for real-time messaging.

What I need you to tackle  
• Profile both the mobile client and the existing Node/JavaScript backend, pinpointing functions, background tasks, or logging that slow the app down, then refactor or remove them without breaking current functionality.  
• Reduce round-trip time for screen loads, device data sync, and control commands to well under a second on a normal 2G connection.  
• Stand up a secure VPS (Ubuntu preferred), install and configure an MQTT broker such as Mosquitto or EMQX, and harden the server (SSL/TLS, firewall rules, basic monitoring).  
• Replace each Firebase feature we use today—authentication, realtime database, cloud functions, and push messaging—with an equivalent self-hosted or lightweight alternative, wiring it all through MQTT where appropriate.  
• Update the mobile app code so all data flows through the new backend, test end-to-end, and publish a clean build.  
• Deliver concise documentation: new architecture diagram, setup steps for the server, and a change log that highlights removed or optimized components.

Acceptance criteria  
1. Cold-start to first data load ≤1 s.  
2. Command round-trip ≤500 ms on 2G.  
3. No runtime errors or feature regressions after Firebase removal.  
4. Clear, reproducible server setup instructions delivered in Markdown.

The existing code is well commented and will be provided along with current Firebase rules and functions. Let’s streamline performance and give the app a lean, self-hosted backbone.

Skills: JavaScript, Linux, Mobile App Development, Node.js, VPS, Ubuntu, MQTT, Backend Development

1. Platform, Multi-Tenancy & Security

Teacher

2. Arabic, English & Internationalization

3. Institution & Academic Management
Schools must manage institution profiles, academic years, terms/semesters, grades, classes, sections, subjects, academic structures and teacher assignments.
The data model must remain flexible for different educational systems.
4. Student Management
Complete student workflows including registration, profiles, enrollment, class assignment, academic information/history, promotion between levels and parent/guardian relationships.
Student data must integrate with attendance, learning, assessments, grades, certificates and parent access.
5. Teacher Workspace
Teachers must manage assigned classes and subjects, students, lessons, learning materials, attendance, assignments, assessments, grading and AI educational tools.
6. Student Portal
Students must access a functional dashboard with courses, lessons, learning materials, assignments/submissions, assessments/exams, results, grades, attendance, certificates, notifications and AI learning assistance.
7. Parent / Guardian Portal
Parents are required in RTIQA v1 and must support multiple children, with secure access to attendance, absences, grades, performance, assignments, assessment results, announcements, notifications and certificates.
8. Attendance
Support present, absent and late status, daily/class attendance, student history and reports, with notification integration where appropriate.
9. Learning Management
Manage courses, units, lessons, learning materials, documents/files, educational media, course structure, student access and learning progress where applicable.
10. Assignments
Complete workflow:
Create → assign → deadline → student submission → teacher review → feedback → grade.
11. Assessments & Exams
Support question banks, multiple choice, true/false and short-answer questions, online/timed assessments, automatic/manual grading, results and academic record integration.
12. Grades & Academic Records
Support grade entry, assessment results, academic performance, progress tracking, report cards and academic history, with flexibility for future grading systems.
13. Certificates & Verification
Required in v1:
Certificate templates
Completion/achievement certificates
Institution branding
Unique certificate IDs
PDF generation
QR code
Public verification page
Certificates must be verifiable digital records, not merely PDFs.
14. Announcements & Notifications
Support targeted announcements for all users, teachers, students, parents or specific classes/groups.
Notification foundation must include in-app and email notifications, with an architecture ready for Push/SMS integration.
15. Dashboards, Reports & Export
Role-based dashboards and useful reports covering school activity, students, attendance, academic performance, classes and teacher activity, with export where appropriate.
16. Practical AI Features
AI must provide real educational value, not simply embed a generic chatbot.
Teachers: lesson planning, quiz/question generation, assignment generation and content summaries.
Students: lesson explanations, simplified explanations, practice questions and revision assistance.
AI architecture must consider security, permissions, tenant isolation, cost control, model-provider flexibility and future RAG/knowledge-base integration.
17. Search, Mobile & Connectivity
Provide search for relevant entities/content including students, teachers, courses and educational materials.
The platform must work well on desktop, tablet and mobile browsers.
Provide a practical foundation for unreliable internet where appropriate, including PWA capabilities, local caching, offline access to suitable content, offline action handling, synchronization architecture and conflict-handling strategy.

items.title: Financial Model Integration and Enhancement
items.description:
Senior Financial Modeling / Accounting Consultant – Integrated Expansion, Financing & 3-Statement Model

We are looking for an experienced finance/accounting professional to take two existing working financial models and integrate and professionalize them into one investor-, lender- and Board-ready model.

We have already completed substantial work and are not starting from a blank sheet. We need someone senior enough to review what has been built, challenge the logic and assumptions, identify any gaps, improve the accounting and financing treatment, and bring the models together using professional financial-modeling standards.

What We Have Today

We currently have two standalone working models that need to be integrated:

Expansion Model → Underlying Project Economics / IRR

Financing Model → Government Grant Bridge + Term Debt + PCH Equity

The Expansion Model includes the current project assumptions around volumes, pricing, incremental operating costs, capital expenditures, government funding, customer capital contributions, taxes and project returns.

The Financing Model has been developed separately to look at how PCH's required contribution could be financed, including government grant bridge financing, term debt, interest, principal repayments, equity requirements, DSCR and liquidity.

Immediate Scope – Integrate the Two Models

The first and immediate deliverable is to combine these two models into one professional integrated Expansion + Financing Model.

The underlying project economics should remain clearly identifiable from the financing structure so that we can separately understand the economics of the expansion and the impact of financing those economics.

The integrated model should clearly and correctly model:

Expansion revenue and operating costs
Expansion operating cash flow
Expansion capital expenditures and construction timing
Government grant funding and timing
Customer capital contributions
PCH permanent capital requirement
Construction-period cash requirements
Government grant bridge financing
Term debt draws
Interest expense and financing fees
Principal repayments and amortization
PCH equity contributions
Cash available for debt service (CFADS)
Debt service coverage ratio (DSCR)
Peak PCH cash/liquidity requirement
Underlying project IRR and NPV
Levered PCH equity IRR and cash returns
Appropriate sensitivities and downside scenarios

The financing structure needs to work properly from a cash perspective. Debt draws, construction expenditures, government reimbursements, bridge repayments, interest, fees and term-debt repayments all need to flow through the model correctly.

We expect the consultant to review and improve the existing work rather than simply combine spreadsheets or accept the existing formulas.

Next Stage – Full PCH Integration

Once the Expansion + Financing Model is complete, the model architecture needs to be set up so that we can subsequently integrate the full existing PCH business:

PCH Financials → Existing Business + Expansion + Financing

The ultimate model should integrate a complete 3-statement forecast:

Income Statement
Balance Sheet
Cash Flow Statement

The existing PCH business, expansion economics and financing should ultimately flow through these statements on a consolidated basis.

The model should therefore be built from the beginning with this future integration in mind. We do not want to have to rebuild the expansion and financing model when the existing business is added.

Covenant & Credit Analysis

The next layer will be:

Covenant Analysis → Consolidated Leverage + CFADS + DSCR + Liquidity

Once the existing business is incorporated, we need to be able to understand the impact of the expansion and financing on the entire company, including consolidated EBITDA and cash flow, total debt and net debt, debt service, CFADS, DSCR, leverage ratios, minimum liquidity, peak funding requirements, covenant compliance and headroom, debt capacity, financing requirements, and downside/stress cases.

The objective is to understand not only whether the expansion generates an acceptable return, but also how it affects the overall PCH business, balance sheet, liquidity and bank covenants.

Returns & Valuation

The integrated model should also incorporate the appropriate investment and valuation metrics, including IRR, NPV and WACC, while clearly distinguishing between:

Underlying project returns before financing
Levered PCH equity returns after financing
Consolidated company financial performance

The model should make it easy to understand how changes in financing assumptions affect equity returns without confusing financing benefits or costs with the underlying economics of the project.

Confidentiality

Confidentiality is extremely important.

For confidentiality reasons, we will not initially provide the complete existing PCH financial statements.

We can provide the GL/account structure and other information necessary to establish the appropriate 3-statement architecture. The model should be designed so that the existing PCH financials can subsequently be populated and integrated efficiently without requiring a significant rebuild.

The consultant will ultimately be working with commercially sensitive project, customer, government funding, financing and company information. We require strict confidentiality and are prepared to have an NDA in place.

What We Are Looking For

Strong finance and accounting experience is mandatory.

This is not simply an Excel assignment. We are looking for someone who understands the finance and accounting behind the formulas and can independently identify issues and improve the work.

Relevant experience would include:

Integrated 3-statement financial modeling
Project and/or infrastructure finance
Construction financing
Term debt and debt amortization
Government grants and bridge financing
Debt sizing
CFADS and DSCR
Bank covenant modeling
Corporate finance
Accounting and tax/depreciation modeling
IRR, NPV and WACC analysis
Capital-intensive businesses
Board/investor/lender financial models
Scenario and sensitivity analysis

CPA/CA, CFA, investment banking, project finance, infrastructure finance, senior FP&A or similar experience would be highly relevant.

We are not looking for someone whose primary qualification is simply advanced Excel skills. We need someone with the financial and accounting background to understand the transaction, challenge the model and build something that can withstand review by management, the Board, investors, lenders and professional advisors.

QGIS — for gathering and aligning geographic/lidar terrain data

Unity — for physics, texturing, rendering, and final environment assembly

Model terrain, bunkers, greens, and water in Blender using OPCD tools
Assemble and texture the course in Unity
Configure gameplay elements (tees, pins, hazards, OOB, scorecard) in Greenskeeper
Optimize for performance and visual quality
Prepare the course for beta testing and community submission

items.title: Geology Field Conference Guidebook Creation
items.description:
The New Mexico Geological Society (NMGS) annually conducts a conference in the Fall known as the Fall Field Conference. The theme of the conference changes each year, focusing on a geologic region in the State of New Mexico.  Accompanying the conference, the technical leaders develop a scientifically oriented guidebook for participants and for later book sales.  The contents of the guidebook are three days of road logs and several referenceable technical papers – anywhere from 12 – 40 pages.  The road logs consist of a description of the geology, natural and local history along the drive, a technical description of each of the several field stops, and some non-referenceable technical papers.  The technical papers are a collection of geological papers that are organized by technical subcategories within the geological disciplines.  Each of these papers can stand alone without the guidebook and is offered to the public free as a standalone publication.

The guidebook project is divided into three separate but interdependent technical organizations: the science editors, the copy editors, and the typesetting, layout, and design.  The science editors gather technical content from the geological community for the guidebook.  They also write the road logs for the three days.  The science editors work with a panel of scientific reviewers for manuscripts and interact with authors on scientific content and adherence to style guidelines.  Once papers have undergone a detailed review, they are passed to the copy editor to address grammar, spelling, punctuation, and adherence to style guidelines, both overall and for the specifics of the geologic area.  The copy editor's corrections are returned to the science editor for confirmation that the copy edits are correct according to geologic context.  Finally, once copy edits are approved, content is passed on for typesetting.  The typesetter then sends the typeset content to the science editor for review and approval.  Ultimately, the typeset product is assembled into a proper book.  Content will include text, photos, and graphics, including tables and charts.

The final product is sent to a printer to print the final guidebook.

items.title: Sci-Fi Photographic Book Cover
items.description:
**Book title:** *IOS*
**Author:** Scott Lambert
**Genre:** Adult science fiction / survival / post-apocalyptic space fiction

The cover should feel **cinematic, serious, atmospheric and high-stakes**, with a strong sense of isolation and scale. The story follows five astronauts stranded aboard the International Orbital Station after nuclear war devastates Earth, so the artwork should immediately communicate **space, survival, catastrophe and the loss of home**.

The main visual should feature the **IOS orbital station** prominently in space, positioned above or near Earth. The station should feel realistic and functional rather than fantasy-like: a large, advanced orbital structure with modular sections, trusses and recognisable engineering detail. It should look like a place people genuinely live and work aboard.

Earth should be visible beneath or behind the station and clearly suffering catastrophic destruction. The planet should still be recognisable as Earth, but with **large areas of fire, glowing atmospheric damage, smoke, illuminated fractures or widespread destruction**. The effect should feel believable and tragic rather than like the planet has literally exploded.

The overall colour palette should be **very dark — black space, deep blues, metallic greys — with strong orange/red light from the damaged Earth**. The contrast between cold space and the burning planet is important.

The title **IOS** should be the dominant typographic element. I would like it large, bold and slightly distressed or weathered, giving it an industrial/survival feel without becoming difficult to read. The title should feel modern and cinematic rather than futuristic in a cliché way.

Above or near the title, include the tagline:

**FIVE PEOPLE. ONE STATION. NO GOING HOME.**

The author name, **SCOTT LAMBERT**, should be clearly visible at the bottom but smaller than the title.

The overall mood should communicate:

**Humanity has just ended below them, and five people are still alive above it.**

Please avoid:

* cartoonish or highly stylised spacecraft
* overly colourful nebulae
* generic Star Wars-style imagery
* visible astronauts or character faces
* anything that makes Earth look completely shattered into pieces
* overly glossy or clean sci-fi aesthetics

The finished cover should look like a **serious adult science-fiction survival novel**, somewhere between hard sci-fi and cinematic disaster fiction.

items.title: PMDC Driver & PCB Design
items.description:
I need a complete electronic design that takes 220 VAC mains and delivers three regulated outputs on a single, production-ready PCB:

• 180 VDC (driving a 0.5 HP permanent-magnet DC motor with PWM speed control)  
• 24 VDC (to power a secondary 24 V motor)  
• 5 VDC (logic rail for an external MCU)

The same board should also be able to switch an AC lamp directly from the 220 VAC line.

Functional expectations  
– PWM is the chosen speed-control method for the main motor.  
– The enclosure will be IP20, so the layout must respect basic finger-safe clearances yet does not need water sealing.  
– Mandatory protections: overload, short-circuit and thermal shutdown on every power rail and the motor driver stage.

What I expect to receive  
1. Schematics, PCB layout and Gerber/ODB++ files ready for fabrication.  
2. A thoroughly cross-checked BOM with manufacturer part numbers and at least two sourcing options for critical parts.  
3. Simulation or bench-test evidence (LTspice, PSpice, … or scope captures) that the driver meets voltage, current and protection specs.  
4. Assembly drawings, test points and a brief production test procedure so a contract manufacturer can build and validate boards without further input.  
5. Optional but appreciated: 3D CAD of the populated board to confirm mechanical fit.

Please note any preferred CAD tool (Altium, KiCad, Eagle, etc.) when you reply—files must be provided in native format as well as neutral outputs. I will be available for quick clarifications and can sign off milestones as each deliverable is reviewed.

items.description:
## Review Quality, Canadian Relevance & Property Management / Real Estate Keywords

The project is not simply to increase the numerical review count. **The quality, relevance, and descriptive content of the new reviews are important deliverables.**

New reviews should come from **genuine Canadian customers or individuals who have actually used or experienced KO Realty's services**.

Where relevant to the customer's actual experience, reviews should naturally contain descriptive terminology related to KO Realty's services, locations, and results.

The objective is to build a large body of highly relevant customer-generated content around topics such as:

* Property management
* Property management company
* Property manager
* Calgary property management
* Calgary property manager
* Rental property management
* Residential property management
* Multifamily property management
* Investment property management
* Tenant placement
* Tenant screening
* Leasing
* Rental management
* Landlord services
* Managing rental properties
* Real estate
* Calgary real estate
* Calgary Realtor
* Real estate brokerage
* Real estate agent
* Investment properties
* Real estate investing
* Multifamily real estate
* Rental properties
* Buying investment properties
* Selling real estate
* Calgary
* Alberta

The contractor should develop a **review-request system that encourages customers to describe their actual experience in detail**, including, where applicable:

* What service they used.
* What type of property was involved.
* The city or market where the service occurred.
* Why they selected KO Realty.
* The problem KO Realty helped solve.
* Their experience with communication and responsiveness.
* Their experience with leasing or tenant placement.
* Their experience with property management.
* Their experience buying or selling real estate.
* Their experience as a landlord or real estate investor.
* Specific outcomes or improvements they experienced.
* Whether they would recommend KO Realty for that particular service.

### Example Review Prompt Strategy

Instead of asking:

**"Please leave us a 5-star review."**

The review-generation process should encourage genuine descriptive feedback, for example:

**"We'd appreciate an honest review about your experience. If helpful, you can mention the service we provided, the type of property you own, the Calgary/Alberta market you worked with us in, and anything our property management or real estate team did particularly well."**

The customer must remain free to write the review in their **own words and give their genuine opinion**.

The contractor must **not provide customers with fabricated reviews to copy and paste** or require customers to insert keywords that do not accurately describe their experience.

### Review Content Target

The contractor should maximize the percentage of newly generated reviews that contain **natural, contextually appropriate property-management, real-estate, service, property-type, and geographic terminology**.

We specifically prefer substantial reviews that describe the customer's experience rather than reviews containing only:

* "Great company"
* "Great service"
* "Highly recommended"
* "5 stars"

The desired review is a genuine customer account containing relevant details such as:

**Service + Property Type + Location + Experience + Outcome**

For example, a genuine landlord who actually used KO Realty's property management service might naturally discuss:

**Calgary + rental property + property management + tenant placement + communication + outcome.**

A genuine investor-client might naturally discuss:

**Calgary real estate + investment property + Realtor + multifamily + purchase experience.**

These are examples of the desired **content structure**, not scripts to be copied by reviewers.

## 60-Day Review Performance Requirement

During the 2-month project, performance will be evaluated based on:

* Number of new genuine reviews.
* Percentage of reviews from genuine Canadian customers.
* Overall Google rating.
* Progress toward **300+ total reviews**.
* Progress toward an overall rating of **greater than 4.9 stars**.
* Percentage of new reviews containing relevant property-management or real-estate terminology where naturally applicable.
* Percentage of new reviews containing relevant geographic terminology such as Calgary or Alberta where naturally applicable.
* Average substantive quality of new reviews.
* Continued operation and good standing of the GBP.
* Absence of review removals, restrictions, or GBP enforcement attributable to the contractor's methods.

## Mandatory GBP Safety Requirement

**Generating keyword-rich reviews cannot come at the expense of the Google Business Profile.**

The contractor must not use:

* Fake Canadian identities.
* Purchased Google accounts.
* Review farms.
* VPN-based location manipulation.
* AI-generated fake customer accounts.
* Mass-created Google profiles.
* Identical or substantially duplicated review text.
* Copy-and-paste review scripts distributed across accounts.
* Paid or incentivized reviews.
* Artificial review velocity intended to manipulate rankings.
* Any technique intended to bypass Google's fake-engagement detection.

Any material Google Business Profile restriction, review restriction, suspension, or enforcement action that is reasonably attributable to the contractor's prohibited activities will constitute **material non-performance**.

The ultimate objective is:

**300+ genuine reviews**

**4.9+ average rating**

**Strong property-management and real-estate topical relevance**

**Significantly improved Calgary Google Maps / GBP rankings**

**No GBP suspension or enforcement caused by the contractor's work**

**Project timeline: 60 days**

items.title: Digit Artwork Optimization for Mobile App
items.description:
NUMBER ASSET CLEANUP & STANDARDIZATION — PRODUCTION BRIEF (initial testing - three numbers)
1. Objective

I have several complete families of number artwork (0–9). The visual design of the numbers is already established.

This job is not to redesign the numbers. The objective is to professionally clean, isolate and standardize the existing artwork so that the numbers can be used as consistent digital assets in a mobile application.

The final result should feel like a coherent 0–9 glyph family, while preserving the original visual character, faceting, materials, reflections and proportions of the supplied artwork.

2. Background Removal & Transparency

For every number:

Completely remove the black/studio background.
Remove the floor reflection and any shadow/reflection beneath the number.
Create a true transparent alpha background.
Clean all exterior edges carefully.
Clean all interior openings/holes, especially in 0, 4, 6, 8 and 9.
Preserve fine crystalline, metallic and translucent edge details wherever possible.
Avoid black/dark halos left by the original background.
Do not simply use an automatic background-removal tool without manually checking and refining the result.

The final asset should contain only the Number Object floating on transparency.

3. Preserve the Original Design

The artist should not reinterpret or redesign the numbers.

Preserve:

silhouette;
faceting;
internal reflections;
colors;
highlights;
crystalline/metallic details;
original depth cues.

Minor retouching is acceptable when necessary to clean AI artifacts or produce a professional transparent asset, but it should not visibly change the approved design.

4. Family Scale & Proportions

All ten numbers should feel as though they belong to the same designed glyph family.

The primary normalization should be based on visual height and scale, not by forcing every digit into exactly the same width.

As a starting principle:

1 should remain clearly narrower than the other digits.
0 and 8 may naturally be among the widest digits.
2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 and 9 should generally occupy a similar standard visual width.
Small variations are acceptable where required by the natural geometry of the glyph.

Do not horizontally stretch a narrow number simply to fill the same width as an 8.

The objective is:

Consistent visual mass and scale, not identical bounding-box width.

5. Height & Alignment

The numbers should have a consistent apparent height when displayed next to each other.

Please establish:

common visual height;
common vertical alignment;
consistent top line;
consistent baseline;
consistent scale across the complete 0–9 family.

Any optical adjustment should be subtle. For example, curved shapes such as 0 or 8 may require tiny scale differences to appear the same height as flatter/angular glyphs.

6. Standard Canvas

The APP-READY assets should all use exactly the same canvas dimensions.

The number should be positioned consistently within that canvas while preserving its natural width.

Therefore, the transparent empty space on the left and right will naturally vary:

1 → more transparent horizontal space
2–7/9 → normal amount
0/8 → less horizontal space

This is intentional.

This will allow the application to control spacing and composition consistently when constructing multi-digit numbers such as:

47 or 258

7. Two Deliverables per Number

Please provide two final versions of every number.

A — CLEAN MASTER

Highest practical resolution.
Lossless PNG with transparency.
Maximum preservation of the original artwork.
Clean isolation and edge treatment.
No floor/reflection/background.
Minimal unnecessary cropping.
Intended as the archival/source-quality asset.

B — APP-READY MASTER

Transparent PNG.
Standardized canvas dimensions shared by all ten digits.
Standardized visual height and alignment.
Correct optical sizing within the family.
Ready for direct testing/composition in the application.

The CLEAN MASTER ensures that future sizing/canvas decisions can always be changed without returning to the original image.

8. Quality Control

Each asset should be inspected at high zoom, particularly:

exterior silhouette;
sharp tips/corners;
translucent edges;
small crystalline facets;
interior holes;

items.title: Expert SEO Francophone pour Stratégie Complète
items.description:
Nous recherchons un(e) expert(e) SEO francophone expérimenté(e) pour prendre en charge l'ensemble de notre stratégie de référencement naturel sur notre site ou plusieurs sites internet.

Il ne s'agit pas d'une mission ponctuelle ou simplement de réaliser un audit SEO. Nous recherchons une personne capable de piloter le SEO de A à Z, de définir les priorités, de mettre en œuvre les optimisations et de suivre les résultats dans la durée.

Objectif principal

Améliorer significativement notre visibilité sur Google sur des mots-clés stratégiques et générer davantage de trafic organique qualifié et de conversions.

Notre activité principale est dans le secteur des logiciels SaaS et de la formation professionnelle en France.

Vos missions

Vous serez notamment responsable de :

Réaliser et maintenir un audit SEO technique complet
Définir une stratégie SEO globale et priorisée
Effectuer les recherches et analyses de mots-clés
Analyser les intentions de recherche et la concurrence
Construire une stratégie de clusters / cocons sémantiques
Définir l'architecture SEO des sites
Optimiser les pages existantes
Identifier les nouvelles pages à créer
Optimiser les Title, Meta Description, H1/H2/H3, URLs et contenus
Améliorer le maillage interne
Détecter et corriger les problèmes de cannibalisation
Travailler le SEO technique : indexation, crawl, sitemap, robots.txt, canonical, redirections, erreurs 404, données structurées, etc.
Analyser et améliorer les Core Web Vitals et les performances
Suivre Google Search Console et Google Analytics
Analyser les positions et leur évolution
Identifier les opportunités à partir des impressions déjà présentes dans Google Search Console
Mettre en place une stratégie de backlinks / netlinking qualitative
Analyser les backlinks des concurrents
Suivre les évolutions des algorithmes Google
Adapter la stratégie SEO aux évolutions liées à l'IA, aux AI Overviews et aux moteurs de recherche génératifs
Préparer des recommandations précises pour la création de contenu
Suivre les résultats : positions, impressions, clics, trafic organique, conversions, backlinks, etc.
Français indispensable

La majorité de nos sites et de nos contenus sont destinés au marché français.

Vous devez donc avoir un excellent niveau de français, notamment pour comprendre :

les intentions de recherche ;
les différences sémantiques entre les mots-clés ;
la qualité des contenus ;
le marché français ;
la terminologie liée aux organismes de formation et aux logiciels SaaS.

Un français approximatif ou uniquement basé sur des outils de traduction ne conviendra pas.

Compétences recherchées

Bonne maîtrise de plusieurs outils parmi :

Google Search Console
Google Analytics / GA4
Screaming Frog
Semrush
Ahrefs
SE Ranking
Google Keyword Planner
PageSpeed Insights / Lighthouse

Une bonne compréhension de WordPress, HTML et du SEO technique est également importante.

La capacité à travailler avec des sites développés sur mesure est un plus.

SEO & Intelligence Artificielle

Nous utilisons déjà beaucoup l'intelligence artificielle dans notre entreprise.

Nous ne sommes donc absolument pas contre l'utilisation de ChatGPT, Claude ou d'autres outils IA.

En revanche, nous recherchons un véritable expert SEO capable d'analyser, réfléchir, vérifier et prendre des décisions, et non une personne qui se contente de générer des audits ou recommandations automatiquement avec une IA.

Ce que nous attendons

Nous voulons travailler avec quelqu'un qui puisse nous dire clairement :

1. Où nous sommes aujourd'hui
2. Quels sont nos principaux problèmes SEO
3. Quelles sont les opportunités les plus importantes
4. Quelles actions doivent être réalisées en priorité
5. Pourquoi nous devons les réaliser
6. Quels résultats nous pouvons raisonnablement attendre
7. Comment les performances évoluent chaque mois

Nous apprécions particulièrement les personnes proactives.

Nous ne voulons pas devoir constamment demander :
« Que devons-nous faire maintenant ? »

Nous attendons de l'expert SEO qu'il analyse les données et nous propose lui-même les prochaines actions.

Pour postuler

Merci de répondre aux questions suivantes :

Depuis combien d'années travaillez-vous dans le SEO ?
Avez-vous déjà travaillé sur des sites français ?
Pouvez-vous nous montrer 2 ou 3 exemples concrets de sites dont vous avez amélioré le référencement ?
Quels étaient les résultats avant/après ?
Quels outils SEO utilisez-vous régulièrement ?
Comment réalisez-vous votre recherche de mots-clés ?
Comment décidez-vous quelles pages doivent être créées en priorité ?
Quelle est votre approche du netlinking ?
Comment analysez-vous une baisse de positionnement Google ?
Comment utilisez-vous l'IA dans votre travail SEO ?
Quelle est votre approche concernant AI Overviews / GEO / moteurs de recherche génératifs ?
Combien d'heures par semaine pourriez-vous consacrer à notre projet ?

Merci de commencer votre candidature par le mot « VISIOSEO » afin que nous sachions que vous avez lu l'annonce jusqu'au bout.

Collaboration

Nous recherchons idéalement une personne avec qui construire une collaboration à long terme.

Si les résultats et la collaboration sont satisfaisants, la mission pourra devenir régulière et concerner plusieurs de nos sites.

Notre priorité n'est pas de trouver le prestataire le moins cher, mais de trouver une personne compétente, fiable, proactive et réellement capable de faire progresser notre référencement.

items.description:
We are seeking a strongly credentialed Internet research and information-retrieval specialist to conduct a comprehensive analysis of publicly available Internet content concerning a discontinued consumer product/brand that was widely marketed approximately 25–35 years ago.

The objective is to determine the volume and nature of current online discussion concerning the historical brand and product.

Scope of Work

The research will focus on two primary questions:

Extent of continuing Internet discussion and recognition.
Identify and quantify publicly available Internet and social-media references concerning the historical brand/product, including consumer recollections, discussions, nostalgia, product descriptions, images, advertising references, and interest in or requests for the product.
Product-category associations.
Analyze the collected references to determine the product category with which Internet users associate the historical brand and the frequency, if any, with which those discussions reference or associate the brand with a separate specified product category.

The research should cover a broad range of publicly available sources, potentially including major search engines, Reddit, Facebook, YouTube, Quora, blogs, discussion forums, nostalgia sites, Internet archives and other relevant online sources.

The researcher should develop and document a thorough search methodology, including search terms and Boolean strings, platforms and search engines searched, date ranges, inclusion/exclusion criteria, treatment of duplicate results, and methodology for categorizing results.

Where feasible, the analysis should provide quantitative findings, including the total number of relevant references identified and the number and percentage falling within the applicable product categories.

Deliverables

The final deliverables should include:

A written report describing the search methodology and findings.
Quantitative results and categorization of the references identified.
A comprehensive Excel or similar source log identifying each relevant result, source/platform, URL, date located, date of content where available, search query through which it was identified, and product-category classification.
Supporting links, screenshots or other source documentation where appropriate.
Qualifications

Candidates should have:

A Master’s degree or doctorate preferred in computer science, information science, data science, information retrieval, search technology, Internet/web analytics, digital forensics, or a closely related technical field.
A substantial academic and/or professional experience demonstrating expertise in Internet searching, information retrieval, search-engine methodology, web research, online data collection, or social-media data analysis.
Demonstrated experience conducting broad, systematic searches across multiple Internet platforms and sources.
Experience collecting, organizing, deduplicating, classifying and quantitatively analyzing substantial numbers of Internet search results.
Strong analytical and report-writing skills.

Experience with advanced Boolean searching, search-engine research, social-media research, web scraping, Python-based data collection, Internet archives, or other methods for systematically identifying and analyzing large numbers of online references is particularly desirable.

Published research, university teaching/research experience, or other significant professional credentials in information retrieval, Internet research or related technical fields are a plus but not a deal breaker.

To Apply

Please provide your experience or CV, highest academic degree, relevant research examples of comparable Internet-search, information-retrieval or large-scale web-research projects.

Please also briefly describe how you would approach a project requiring a broad Internet search to identify and categorize online references to a particular historical consumer brand.

The identity of the product and the specific comparison category will be provided to selected candidates.

• Diagnose the authorization fault and document the root cause

– Machine starts without error on five consecutive power cycles  
– All axes home, jog, and cut accurately within factory tolerances  
– Final source or binary delivered on a USB stick with clear reinstall steps

I have finished the high-level electrical design for a custom flight-controller dedicated to drone control and now need a seasoned PCB specialist to turn it into a production-ready board. The core is an STM32H743VIT6 and the layout must follow the MicoAir743v2 reference as closely as practical so that mounting holes, connector orientation, and general part zones remain familiar to technicians already using that platform.

What is already defined  
• Complete schematic with dual ICM-20948 IMUs, dual MS5611 barometers, FDCAN1 & FDCAN2, SDMMC1 microSD logging, GH-series connectors, and a documented 6 S power tree feeding 5 V, 3 .3 V and 1 .8 V rails plus dual BEC outputs.

• Mechanical constraint: compact footprint—the closer to the original reference outline, the better.

What I need from you  
1. Clean, DRC-passing PCB layout in Altium, KiCad or another mainstream tool we agree on.  
2. Gerbers, drill files, pick-and-place, and annotated BOM ready for fabrication and assembly.  
3. 3D step model so I can check stack-ups in the airframe CAD.

Key considerations  
• Keep high-current 6 S traces short and wide; respect creepage/clearance for up to 30 V.  
• Maintain matched-length lines for SDMMC and IMU SPI connections.  
• Preserve the original thermal strategy—MCU, IMUs and regulators sit where the reference puts them, unless a clear thermal or routing win dictates otherwise.  
• EMI discipline around the twin CAN transceivers is essential.

If you have shipped compact, high-speed STM32H7 boards before—especially for multirotors—let’s talk. I can provide the full schematic PDF and reference source files as soon as we start.

# Moroccan AI Voice & WhatsApp Developer Needed — MVP / Technical Partnership

## Project Overview

I am launching a new AI automation project in Morocco focused on intelligent communication solutions using **AI Voice Agents and WhatsApp AI Agents**.

I am currently looking for a **Moroccan developer or technical freelancer** who can help me build a small working MVP that I can demonstrate to potential B2B clients.

The initial goal is NOT to build a large platform. I need a simple, professional prototype that works reliably and can later be expanded.

## MVP Requirements

The first version should include:

### 1. AI Voice Agent

* AI voice assistant capable of speaking naturally in **Moroccan Darija and Arabic**
* Receive a phone call and have a natural conversation
* Answer questions using a predefined knowledge base
* Collect basic information from the caller
* Handle common questions and requests
* Record/transcribe the conversation if technically appropriate

### 2. WhatsApp AI Agent

* AI assistant connected to WhatsApp
* Respond to incoming messages
* Understand Moroccan Darija / Arabic
* Answer using approved information
* Collect basic information
* Escalate or hand over when the AI cannot answer

### 3. Basic Integration

You should be comfortable working with technologies such as:

* Retell AI / Vapi or similar Voice AI platforms
* ElevenLabs or another suitable voice platform
* Twilio or another telephony API
* WhatsApp Business API
* OpenAI or another LLM
* APIs and webhooks
* Basic database/backend integration

You do NOT need to use exactly these technologies if you have a better technical solution.

## Important: Moroccan Darija

A major requirement is **natural Moroccan Darija**.

The final voice should sound as natural as possible for a Moroccan user, not like translated standard Arabic.

Experience with Arabic/Darija voice AI is a strong advantage.
## What Will the AI Agent Talk About?

The AI agent will be designed as an **AI communication assistant for Moroccan political parties, candidates, and campaign teams**.

Each client will provide the agent with their own **official and approved information**, such as the party's or candidate's presentation, political program, campaign priorities, public events, office/contact information, frequently asked questions, and other non-sensitive information that they want citizens to receive.

For example, a citizen could call or message the AI and ask:

* What is the party's political program?
* What are the main priorities of the candidate?
* What does the party propose regarding employment, education, healthcare, housing, infrastructure, or other public issues?
* Where and when is a campaign event taking place?
* How can I contact the local campaign office?
* What are the official campaign activities and announcements?
* Can you explain this point from the party's program?

The AI should answer **only from the information approved and provided by the client**, communicate naturally in **Moroccan Darija and Arabic**, and avoid inventing information or answering questions outside its authorized knowledge.

The system should also have clear guardrails so that the AI does not present itself as a human, does not invent political statements, and can transfer or escalate conversations to a human campaign representative when a question requires human intervention.

The long-term vision is to provide each political party, candidate, or campaign team with its own configurable AI agent that can be trained on their official information and used across **voice calls and WhatsApp**, while keeping the technology and core system reusable for different clients.

## What I Am Looking For

I am looking for someone who:

* Is based in Morocco or understands the Moroccan market
* Has experience building AI agents
* Has experience with Voice AI, WhatsApp automation, APIs and LLMs
* Can build a clean MVP quickly
* Can communicate clearly in English, French or Arabic
* Is interested in a longer-term collaboration

## Partnership / Payment

I want to be completely transparent:

**I am currently in the launch stage and do not have a large upfront development budget.**

Therefore, I am looking for a developer interested in a **technical partnership / deferred-payment arrangement**.

My responsibility:

* Business development
* Finding potential clients
* Sales
* Client presentations and demos
* Product/business strategy

Your responsibility:

* Technical development
* AI agent setup
* API integrations
* MVP implementation

The initial objective is to create a **small demonstrable MVP**, not a complete enterprise platform.

We can agree in advance on the developer's compensation for the first client/project, including a deferred-payment or revenue-sharing structure.

I am NOT asking someone to work indefinitely for free. I want to establish a clear agreement from the beginning.

## To Apply

Please send:

1. A short introduction about yourself
2. Your location in Morocco
3. Examples of AI/Voice/WhatsApp projects you have built
4. Which technologies you normally use
5. Whether you have experience with Retell, Vapi, ElevenLabs, Twilio, WhatsApp API or OpenAI
6. Whether you have built an AI voice agent before
7. Your preferred collaboration/payment arrangement for an MVP with limited upfront budget

**Please only apply if you are genuinely comfortable building AI agents and API integrations.**

I am looking for a serious long-term technical partner, not just someone to complete one small coding task.

Segment audio line-by-line based on semantic coherence (average segment length: 5–6 seconds; maximum 8 seconds).

[N] for background noise

[OVERLAP/][/OVERLAP] for simultaneous speech

[LAUGHTER] for non-verbal laughter

[OIVS] for non-recording human background voices (TV, radio, background chatter)

* for inaudible/unclear words

Requirements & Qualifications
Native or high-level proficiency in European Portuguese (EP). Note: Audio entirely in Brazilian Portuguese (BP) is considered invalid for this project.

Exceptional listening skills and high attention to rule-based guidelines.

We are seeking detail-oriented native or fluent European Portuguese (EP) linguists/annotators for an audio processing project involving customer service dialogues across four sectors: Healthcare, Public Sector, Energy, and NGO.

The work involves audio segmentation, speaker role tagging, and accurate verbatim transcription.

Key Responsibilities
Audio Segmentation & Alignment:

Segment audio line-by-line based on semantic coherence (average segment length: 5–6 seconds; maximum 8 seconds).

Maintain clean silence margins around audio cuts (100ms–150ms) while avoiding speech truncation or sudden noise inclusions.

Speaker & Attribute Tagging:

Tag audio-level attributes (Gender: Male/Female; Role: Operator/Customer).

Assign sentence-level speaker IDs (e.g., 01, C1, 02, C2 for multi-speaker dialogues).

Verbatim Transcription & Special Tagging:

Provide verbatim transcription matching spoken words exactly.

Transcribe numbers as full words (no Arabic numerals allowed).

Apply specific structural and acoustic tags:

[N] for background noise

[OVERLAP/][/OVERLAP] for simultaneous speech

[LAUGHTER] for non-verbal laughter

[PIL] for sensitive private information (addresses, phone numbers, IDs)

[OIVS] for non-recording human background voices (TV, radio, background chatter)

* for inaudible/unclear words

Requirements & Qualifications
Native or high-level proficiency in European Portuguese (EP). Note: Audio entirely in Brazilian Portuguese (BP) is considered invalid for this project.

Exceptional listening skills and high attention to rule-based guidelines.

Prior experience with audio annotation tools (DataPlus, Audacity, Praat, CVAT, or similar) is preferred.

Ability to meet strict quality benchmarks:

Word Transcription Accuracy: ≥ 98%

Speaker Role Accuracy: ≥ 97%

Special Label Accuracy: ≥ 90%

How to Apply
Please submit your proposal including:

Your rate per audio hour.

Summary of your experience with audio annotation or transcription in European Portuguese.

Your daily availability (hours/day).

items.description:
Full-Stack Property Management, CRM, Marketplace & Field Operations Platform

We are looking for an experienced senior full-stack developer or small product engineering team to build a complete, production-grade property management operating system for an Indian real-estate/property-management company.

This is not a simple website or admin panel. The requirement is for an integrated SaaS-style platform combining a public property marketplace, CRM, property-management operations, customer portals, field operations, finance workflows and employee/HR functions within a single system.

Core Product Scope

The system should have four interconnected application surfaces sharing one central backend:

1. Public Website + Property Marketplace
SEO-optimized responsive website, city/locality landing pages, Buy/Rent/Lease listings, property search and filters, property detail pages, owner-property submission, tenant requirements, enquiry capture, visit booking, lead/referral intake and customer authentication.

2. Internal Operations / CRM
Desktop-first operations system for property acquisition, tenant acquisition, lead management, property onboarding, property master, owner/tenant profiles, visit scheduling, follow-ups, negotiations, agreements, move-in/move-out, inspections, inventory, keys, maintenance, rent collection, vendor management, documents, tasks, SLA/TAT monitoring and complete operational timelines.

The CRM must support assignment by employee, department, city and role, with controlled reassignment, audit trails, duplicate detection, workflow/state-machine rules and role-based access.

3. Owner & Tenant Customer Portal
Customers should be able to log in and view their properties/tenancy, agreements, payments, rent information, maintenance requests, inspections, documents, visits, approvals, support requests, notifications and action-required items.

4. Mobile-First Field Operations
Field executives require a dedicated mobile interface for assigned visits/jobs, GPS-based check-in/out, property inspections, onboarding, photography, inventory verification, meter readings, key handover, move-in/out, maintenance verification, evidence/photos, navigation and job completion.

Employee / HRMS

The platform should also include a native HR layer linked to the same employee identity system:

Employee master and access control
Departments/designations/reporting managers
Roles and city assignments
Shifts and weekly offs
Attendance and GPS punch
Leave balances, leave requests and approvals
Attendance regularization
Employee documents
Workforce availability
Employee self-service “My HR”
Manager/team HR dashboard
Salary structures
Shadow payroll processing
Payslips and downloadable PDF salary slips
Technical Expectations

Preferred modern stack:

React 19 + TypeScript + TanStack Start/Router/Query + Vite + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui + Supabase/PostgreSQL.

The backend should use PostgreSQL with strong Row Level Security (RLS), secure server-side privileged operations, audit logging, role/city-based authorization, object/document storage and API/RPC boundaries.

The product must be responsive, premium and highly polished, with the public/customer experience optimized for mobile, the internal operations system optimized for laptop/desktop, and Field Ops optimized for mobile.

Integrations

Architecture should support integrations such as:

WhatsApp/SMS/email notifications
MSG91 or similar communication provider
Razorpay/payment gateway
Google Maps/Places/Geocoding
Google Calendar
Telephony
Accounting integration such as Zoho Books
Document/PDF generation
OTP authentication

All real provider activation should be environment-controlled and secure.

Security & Quality Requirements

This is a business-critical application. We expect:

Proper RBAC and city-level access restrictions
Supabase/Postgres RLS
Secure server-side privileged operations
No secret/service-role keys in frontend code
Audit logs
Controlled workflow/state transitions
Idempotent backend operations where required
Automated tests
TypeScript/typecheck compliance
Production-grade error handling
Separate staging and production environments
Migration/version discipline
Clean Git-based development workflow
Expected Freelancer

We prefer someone who has previously built large SaaS, ERP, CRM, property-management, logistics, field-service or marketplace platforms, rather than only landing pages or basic CRUD dashboards.

Please provide:

Similar systems you have built
Proposed architecture and technology stack
Team size
Estimated development timeline
Fixed-price or milestone-wise quotation
Post-launch warranty/support period
Whether UI/UX, backend, DevOps, testing and deployment are included

Important: We already understand the required product deeply and can provide detailed workflows, schemas, business rules and reference screens. We are looking for someone capable of implementing the complete system to production quality, not merely creating a prototype.

Steady-state pressure-drop analysis for several operating elevations.
Pressure-versus-elevation profiling of a long vertical concrete pumping pipeline.
Non-Newtonian/slurry flow modelling using appropriate concrete rheological properties.
Hydraulic reaction-force calculations for critical horizontal elbow locations.
Dynamic transient / shock-wave analysis for selected operating events such as pump startup, shutdown, and emergency trip.
Determination of maximum transient pressures and governing hydraulic force vectors.
Structural piping analysis of selected intermediate vertical riser anchors/supports.
Calculation of anchor reactions including:
Fx, Fy, Fz
Mx, My, Mz
Assessment of pipe wall-thickness safety factors for very high dynamic operating pressures.

Mathcad

items.description:
A new ALMA logo treatment may hearken to the original, but should help evolve ALMA's representation for (a) the current times and potentially (b) our shift towards equality focus (human and civil rights), as opposed to reunion. ALMA has always been concerned with equality (and vital efforts through litigation); however, was best known for registry and supporting reunion (roughly late 1970s - 2024). 

As our formal name is The ALMA Society, Inc., a sub-logo treatment / work mark may assist us.

ALMA mission:  To empower adopted people by restoring equal access to their own identifying birth information. 

The Adoptees' Liberty Movement Association (ALMA) was founded and incorporated as a not-for-profit in the State of New York in 1971. It is the first organization in the U.S. developed to champion the restoration of rights of adopted persons to self-identifying information. ALMA undertook litigation in the mid-1970s with a view to advance this movement. The ALMA Reunion Registry has been instrumental in otherwise facilitating reunions of many thousands of people touched by adoption. The Alma Society, Inc. has been a 501(c)(3), tax-exempt corporation since 1977. 

I've attached the original logo, we like the curved letters (that people recognize, but want to move away from the mother and child image into a more modern look) 

Deliverables

items.description:
# Portal Médico de Prótesis e Implantes

## Concepto general

Desarrollo de una plataforma web especializada para la comercialización y distribución de prótesis, implantes y dispositivos médicos dirigidos exclusivamente a profesionales de la salud, clínicas, hospitales y centros especializados.

El objetivo del sitio será facilitar el proceso de consulta, selección y compra de productos médicos, permitiendo que cada profesional pueda crear una cuenta, acceder a un catálogo especializado y realizar sus pedidos directamente desde la plataforma.

La empresa se encargará posteriormente de la preparación, logística y entrega de los productos en el consultorio, clínica u hospital indicado por el médico.

---

# ¿Cómo funcionará?

### 1. Registro del profesional

Para acceder al portal, el médico o profesional deberá crear una cuenta proporcionando información como:

* Nombre completo
* Especialidad médica
* Cédula profesional
* Hospital, clínica o consultorio
* Ciudad
* Estado
* Teléfono
* Correo electrónico
* Dirección de entrega

La empresa podrá validar la información antes de habilitar completamente la cuenta.

---

### 2. Acceso privado para médicos

Una vez aprobado el registro, el profesional contará con un usuario y contraseña para ingresar a su portal privado.

Desde su cuenta podrá:

* Consultar el catálogo completo.
* Buscar productos por especialidad.
* Consultar precios.
* Revisar características técnicas.
* Descargar fichas técnicas.
* Revisar disponibilidad.
* Agregar productos al carrito.
* Realizar pedidos.
* Registrar diferentes direcciones de entrega.
* Consultar pedidos anteriores.
* Revisar el estatus de sus compras.
* Descargar facturas o comprobantes.
* Solicitar soporte especializado.

---

# Catálogo de productos

La plataforma deberá permitir organizar los productos por especialidad y tipo de procedimiento.

Ejemplo:

## Rodilla

* Prótesis total de rodilla
* Prótesis parcial
* Componentes femorales
* Componentes tibiales
* Insertos
* Instrumental
* Sistemas de revisión

## Cadera

* Prótesis total de cadera
* Vástagos femorales
* Copas acetabulares
* Cabezas femorales
* Insertos
* Sistemas de revisión

## Hombro

* Prótesis anatómicas
* Prótesis reversas
* Componentes glenoidales
* Componentes humerales
* Instrumental

## Trauma

* Placas
* Tornillos
* Clavos
* Sistemas de fijación
* Instrumental quirúrgico

Podrán agregarse posteriormente nuevas especialidades o categorías.

---

# Información de cada producto

Cada producto contará con una página individual donde se mostrará:

* Nombre del producto
* Marca
* Categoría
* Especialidad
* Fotografías
* Descripción
* Indicaciones
* Características técnicas
* Material
* Medidas disponibles
* Variantes
* Compatibilidad entre componentes
* Disponibilidad
* Precio
* Ficha técnica descargable en PDF
* Instrucciones o documentación adicional

Botón:

**Agregar al pedido**

---

# Proceso de compra

El médico podrá seleccionar los productos que necesita y agregarlos a su carrito.

Posteriormente deberá confirmar:

### Productos

Productos, cantidades, medidas y referencias.

### Datos del procedimiento

Opcionalmente podrá indicar:

* Fecha de cirugía
* Hospital o clínica
* Médico responsable
* Información adicional relacionada con el procedimiento

### Dirección de entrega

El profesional podrá seleccionar su consultorio, clínica, hospital u otra dirección previamente registrada.

### Forma de pago

La plataforma podrá integrar diferentes modalidades:

* Tarjeta de crédito
* Tarjeta de débito
* Transferencia bancaria
* Crédito autorizado
* Pago mediante convenio comercial

Después de confirmar el pedido, el médico recibirá una notificación con el número de orden.

---

# Seguimiento del pedido

Desde su cuenta el profesional podrá visualizar el estado de cada solicitud:

**Pedido recibido**

↓

**Pedido confirmado**

↓

**Preparando pedido**

↓

**En proceso de envío**

↓

**En camino**

↓

**Entregado**

El sistema podrá enviar actualizaciones automáticamente por correo electrónico y, en una segunda etapa, mediante WhatsApp.

---

# Página principal

## Soluciones médicas especializadas, directamente hasta donde las necesitas.

Accede a nuestro catálogo profesional de prótesis, implantes y dispositivos médicos.

Consulta productos, especificaciones técnicas y realiza tus pedidos desde un solo lugar.

Nosotros nos encargamos de llevarlos hasta tu consultorio, clínica u hospital.

**[Crear cuenta profesional]**

**[Ingresar al portal]**

---

# Encuentra la solución adecuada para cada procedimiento

Accede a nuestro catálogo especializado para cirugía ortopédica y procedimientos médicos.

### Rodilla

Soluciones y sistemas especializados para reemplazo y reconstrucción de rodilla.

### Cadera

Implantes y componentes para procedimientos de reemplazo de cadera.

### Hombro

Sistemas anatómicos y reversos para cirugía de hombro.

### Trauma

Soluciones para fijación, reconstrucción y procedimientos traumatológicos.

**Ver catálogo**

---

# Una nueva forma de gestionar tus pedidos médicos

Nuestro portal está diseñado para facilitar el trabajo de profesionales de la salud.

### Catálogo especializado

Consulta productos, especificaciones, medidas y documentación técnica.

### Pedidos en línea

Realiza tus solicitudes desde cualquier dispositivo.

### Entrega especializada

Recibe los productos directamente en tu consultorio, clínica u hospital.

### Historial de compras

Consulta todos tus pedidos desde tu cuenta profesional.

### Atención personalizada

Obtén soporte para selección de productos, disponibilidad y logística.

---

# ¿Cómo comprar?

### 01. Regístrate

Crea tu cuenta como profesional de la salud.

### 02. Accede al catálogo

Consulta productos y especificaciones.

### 03. Realiza tu pedido

Selecciona productos, cantidades y dirección de entrega.

### 04. Nosotros nos encargamos del resto

Preparamos y enviamos el pedido directamente al lugar indicado.

---

# Portal profesional

El sitio deberá contar con un área privada donde cada médico pueda administrar su información.

## Mi cuenta

* Datos personales
* Cédula profesional
* Especialidad
* Hospitales relacionados
* Direcciones de entrega
* Datos de facturación
* Formas de pago

## Mis pedidos

* Pedidos activos
* Pedidos anteriores
* Seguimiento
* Facturas
* Repetir pedido

## Productos favoritos

El médico podrá guardar productos utilizados frecuentemente para facilitar futuras compras.

---

# Solicitar asesoría

En productos especializados será importante ofrecer también la posibilidad de solicitar atención personalizada.

**¿Necesitas apoyo para seleccionar un producto?**

Nuestro equipo puede ayudarte a identificar la solución adecuada según tus requerimientos.

**Hablar con un asesor**

---

# Funciones administrativas para la empresa

Además del portal para médicos, la empresa deberá contar con un panel administrativo desde donde pueda gestionar:

* Médicos registrados
* Validación de cuentas
* Productos
* Categorías
* Inventario
* Precios
* Promociones
* Pedidos
* Estados de envío
* Clientes
* Hospitales
* Facturación
* Reportes
* Usuarios internos

También deberá ser posible asignar precios especiales a determinados médicos, distribuidores, hospitales o grupos de clientes.

---

# Funcionalidades recomendadas

La plataforma deberá considerar:

* Diseño responsive para celular, tablet y computadora.
* Registro de profesionales.
* Validación de usuarios.
* Inicio de sesión seguro.
* Recuperación de contraseña.
* Catálogo con buscador.
* Filtros por especialidad, marca, categoría y producto.
* Carrito de compras.
* Checkout.
* Pasarela de pagos.
* Integración con sistema de inventario.
* Integración con facturación.
* Sistema de seguimiento de pedidos.
* Notificaciones por correo.
* Integración futura con WhatsApp.
* Descarga de fichas técnicas.
* Historial de pedidos.
* Productos favoritos.
* Repetición rápida de pedidos.
* Panel administrativo.
* Gestión de inventario.
* Estadísticas y reportes.

---

# Estructura sugerida del sitio

### Sitio público

1. Inicio
2. Nosotros
3. Especialidades
4. Productos
5. Cómo funciona
6. Registro profesional
7. Contacto
8. Aviso de privacidad
9. Términos y condiciones

### Portal privado

1. Dashboard
2. Catálogo
3. Mis favoritos
4. Carrito
5. Mis pedidos
6. Seguimiento
7. Facturación
8. Direcciones
9. Mi cuenta
10. Soporte

---

# Objetivo de la plataforma

Transformar el proceso tradicional de solicitud de prótesis e implantes médicos en una experiencia digital más rápida, organizada y eficiente.

La plataforma permitirá que los profesionales de la salud puedan gestionar sus compras directamente, mientras que la empresa centraliza pedidos, inventario, atención comercial y logística dentro de un mismo ecosistema digital.

El resultado será un canal comercial B2B disponible 24/7 que permitirá aumentar la eficiencia operativa, mejorar la experiencia del médico y facilitar el crecimiento de la empresa.

items.title: Autonomous LED Environmental Display System
items.description:
I’m building a small, self-contained LED setup that doesn’t just blink for show—it should read the surrounding environment and translate that data into a clear visual output. The core idea is simple: onboard sensors feed live information to a strip or matrix of LEDs, and the viewer instantly knows the current conditions without checking a screen.

Right now I’m committed to environmental sensing/display as the primary function; which specific parameters we track (temperature, humidity, air-quality or others you suggest) and how we map them to colour shifts, patterns, or even a numeric read-out is still open. I’m keen to hear creative approaches that keep the interface intuitive at a glance.

I picture a compact board—Arduino, ESP32, Raspberry Pi Pico or a similarly low-power microcontroller—driving addressable LEDs. It should run from a single USB-C or battery pack, sleep efficiently when conditions are stable, and wake instantly on changes. A simple calibration routine and a way to tweak thresholds via serial or Bluetooth would be ideal.

Deliverables
• Schematic and full BOM ready for ordering  
• Clean, well-commented firmware (C/C++ or MicroPython) with clear mapping between sensor values and LED behaviour  
• Assembly guide plus short video or photos that prove the prototype performs as specified  
• Quick-start user notes so anyone can flash firmware, power up, and see it work

Acceptance criteria
The prototype must power on, auto-detect the chosen sensors, and update the LEDs in real time; any sensor reading outside a safe range should trigger a noticeably different visual state so it’s obvious even from across a room.

If you have a solid track record with IoT, sensor fusion or LED artistry and can package everything into a tidy, reproducible build, I’m ready to get moving.
