I am looking for an experienced **residential architect, house designer, architectural technologist, or multidisciplinary design team** to design a custom single-storey home and produce a **complete architectural/construction drawing and 3D rendering package**.

## PROJECT SIZE

**Maximum overall house footprint: approximately 96' wide x 48' deep (4,608 sq. ft.)**

The project will be located in **New Brunswick, Canada**.

I will provide my room requirements, approximate dimensions, sketches, and several pictures/renderings/floor plans for inspiration.

**All pictures and plans I provide are examples and design inspiration only. They are NOT intended to be copied exactly.**

The designer is expected to create an original, functional and buildable design based on my requirements.

## REQUIRED ROOMS / APPROXIMATE DIMENSIONS

**Master Suite – 16' x 43'**

* Bedroom
* Large ensuite
* Walk-in closet

**Open-Concept Great Room – 16' x 48'**

* Two bedrooms

**Service Spine – approximately 22' x 12'**

* Mudroom
* Laundry

* Efficient garage-to-kitchen/pantry circulation

**Media / Game Room – 18' x 22'**

Also required:

* Main foyer/entrance
* Coat closet
* Guest half bathroom
* Pantry/storage
* Mechanical/utilities as required
* Efficient circulation throughout the house

Dimensions are design targets and may be adjusted slightly where necessary to produce a better overall plan.

## DESIGN DIRECTION

The preferred architecture is **modern Scandinavian / Nordic with subtle Japanese influence**.

I am looking for:

* Clean, simple exterior forms
* Modern rooflines
* Large windows
* Natural materials
* Wood and stone accents
* Warm minimalist interiors
* High ceilings where appropriate
* Strong indoor/outdoor connection
* Excellent natural light
* Energy-efficient cold-climate construction
* Practical construction rather than unnecessarily complicated architectural features

## PHASE 1 – CONCEPT & FLOOR PLAN DESIGN

Before detailed construction drawings begin, I want the overall house layout properly optimized.

This should include:

* Initial concept plans
* Room adjacency optimization
* Circulation analysis
* Furniture layouts
* Door/window locations
* Kitchen layout
* Bathroom layouts
* Garage layout
* Service-spine layout

* Reflected ceiling plan

* Bathroom layouts
* Millwork/cabinetry layouts
* Exterior material specifications
* General construction notes

## PHASE 3 – FOUNDATION & STRUCTURAL COORDINATION

* Foundation plan
* Footing layout
* Slab/floor construction
* Load-bearing wall locations
* Beam locations
* Column/post locations
* Roof framing concept
* Structural sections/details
* Coordination of major openings and spans

If structural engineering must legally be completed or stamped by a licensed Canadian/New Brunswick engineer, clearly identify this in your proposal.

## PHASE 4 – ELECTRICAL & LIGHTING PLAN

* Exterior lighting
* Recessed lights
* Decorative fixtures
* Switch locations
* Receptacle locations

* Bathroom electrical

* Home gym electrical

We are expanding our freelance roster, and we are currently seeking to fill two distinct roles: an **AI Video Creator** and a **Video Editor**. As an independent film studio dedicated to cinematic digital storytelling across live-action, traditional animation, and generative AI, we are looking for reliable talent to help bring our narrative shorts and episodic series to life.

*Note: You may apply for just one of these roles, or if you are a hybrid creator with expertise in both AI generation and traditional post-production, you are welcome to apply for both.*

### **Role 1: AI Video Creator (Image-to-Video & Immersive POV)**

We need an AI specialist to transform static images, written concepts, and reference materials into fluid, high-quality video clips, with a major focus on crafting immersive, first-person POV scenes.

* **Generate & Animate:** Turn static images and detailed scripts into realistic video content with natural camera and character motion.
* **Craft POV Experiences:** Produce believable first-person environments and interactions without distracting visual errors or "hallucinations."
* **Maintain Continuity:** Ensure strict visual consistency across characters, lighting, perspective, and complex elements (like hands and objects) throughout all scenes.

### **Role 2: Video Editor (Post-Production & Assembly)**

* **VFX & Compositing:** Utilize masking methods and compositing to fix minor AI glitches, blend scenes seamlessly, and enhance the overall visual style.
* **Software Proficiency:** Expert-level editing utilizing Adobe Premiere Pro, Adobe After Effects, and/or DaVinci Resolve.
* **Collaborate:** Work closely with the creative lead and the AI Video Creator to ensure the final deliverable perfectly matches the intended storyboard and script.

### **What You Bring**

* **For the AI Creator:** Proven experience using top-tier platforms (e.g., Runway, Sora, Kling, Midjourney, Pika, Veo) and strong prompt engineering skills.
* **For the Editor:** Strong background in narrative film editing, workflow management, color grading, and audio syncing.
* **For Both Roles:** A deep understanding of cinematic composition, lighting, and visual storytelling. The ability to work independently on an as-needed basis while following precise creative direction.

5. Your hourly rate or estimated cost per completed minute of video.

*Please note: Applications without relevant work samples will not be considered. If successful, ongoing as-needed work will be available.*

items.title: Stripe and HubSpot Automation Specialist Required
items.description:
I run a boutique U.S. expat tax firm. My marketing site is built and complete in Framer by a separate designer. I need an automation specialist to connect the site's checkout flow to Stripe and HubSpot, and to automate document handling for clients using Google Drive (a separate client portal already exists for other clients and needs no automation work), so that pricing, payments, document routing, and client communication across email, text, and WhatsApp all run automatically instead of me doing any of it by hand.

You'll be coordinating with my web designer as needed, we communicate in Slack, and he'll connect the Framer side of things (forms, page endpoints) to whatever you build. You won't need Framer access yourself, just to work with him on where things connect.

This is not a custom development project. No backend server or database to build. You'll work entirely with existing tools: Stripe's API, HubSpot workflows, and Zapier (or direct API calls) connecting the two.

No design work, backend automation only. I also need help setting up HubSpot properly from scratch, I'm not experienced with it and want your advice on structure, not just automation.

What needs to be built:

HubSpot setup. Pipelines, custom contact properties (tier selected, price, documents received, last upload date, and similar tracking fields), and general account structure. I need your advice on best practices since I'm new to HubSpot.

A pricing calculation engine. I have a complete, fixed-dollar pricing formula already written: a base price for each service tier, plus a defined list of dollar add-ons triggered by specific complexity factors (number of states, income sources, foreign accounts, and several others). Some combinations of answers route to a fixed price automatically, others route to a "requires a conversation" outcome instead of an automatic price. This is fully specified already, your job is implementation, not design.

Dynamic Stripe checkout. My current Stripe setup only supports fixed-price payment links. I need a calculated, variable dollar amount charged at checkout, generated as a one-time payment link through Stripe's API rather than through Stripe Invoicing, since Invoicing carries a per-invoice fee I want to avoid.

A deposit and balance payment sequence. Clients pay a deposit at checkout. Later, the remaining balance needs to charge automatically, triggered by a status change I make in HubSpot (for example, moving a deal to "ready for review"). No manual invoice creation at any point.

Engagement letter agreement. Before checkout, clients need to agree to my engagement letter via clickwrap, a checkbox plus a timestamp captured at the moment of agreement, legally sufficient for this document, no e-signature tool needed. This record should be stored and associated with the client.

Document routing automation. Some clients upload documents to a Google Drive folder, others use a separate portal I already manage. I decide who goes where manually, that routing itself doesn't need automation. For Google Drive clients specifically: automatically create their folder once their deposit is paid, and use a structured intake form with labeled upload fields (not one open folder) so submissions land in the right place automatically.

HubSpot pipeline workflows tied to that Google Drive path: automated status-based emails, and a notification to me when a client uploads a file, plus a weekly digest of anyone who hasn't uploaded after a set number of days.

A signature detection workflow. I use Adobe Acrobat Sign for e-signatures, but my plan doesn't include webhook or API access. I need an automation that watches my Gmail inbox for a specific sender address and a specific subject line pattern that indicates a document has been fully signed, and fires downstream actions (updating HubSpot, sending a follow-up email) when that match occurs.

Communication logging. Every email, text message, and WhatsApp message with a client should log automatically to that client's HubSpot contact record, along with whatever contact method they said they prefer.

Email template integration. I've already written the exact copy for roughly 19 different client-facing emails covering every stage of the process (payment confirmations, document requests, status updates, and so on). You're wiring these into the correct HubSpot triggers, not writing any of the copy yourself.

Payment failure and refund handling. If an automatic balance charge fails, I need to be notified immediately rather than it silently retrying. If I manually refund someone in Stripe, that should be reflected on their HubSpot record.

I'm looking for someone who can both configure this correctly and explain their reasoning to me along the way, since I'll be managing this system myself once it's live. Please include in your proposal: your experience with Stripe and HubSpot specifically, a rough time estimate, and an example of a similar automation project you've completed. 

Finally, I am not a technical person, and I know that going in. What I need most from whoever takes this on is honesty and patience, not just task completion. If something I've asked for is unclear, overbuilt, unnecessary, or could be done more simply, tell me before you start, not after you've already built it the expensive way. If you notice a gap in what I've described, something I clearly need but haven't thought to ask for, point it out. I would much rather hear "this is missing" or "this doesn't quite make sense" than have you build exactly what I wrote to the letter and leave me with something that technically matches my request but doesn't actually work for my business.

This is not a rush job for me, and I'm not looking for someone who wants to check boxes and move on to the next project. I'm looking for someone who will actually think about what I'm trying to accomplish and treat this as a real, ongoing working relationship, at least through launch and likely beyond, since I'll need help maintaining and adjusting this system as my business grows. Please include in your proposal how you typically handle a client who isn't technical and needs things explained along the way, not just delivered.  Do not copy and paste my project description and reiterate it back to me.  Don't hunt me down on social media or send me emails.  If you are the right person to work with I'll know.  Thank you kindly.

### HOW THE BUSINESS WORKS

Customers purchase a Mystery Authenticated Signed CD.

Some packages will contain a physical card with a unique redemption code for a valuable premium framed autograph prize.

There will initially be approximately 5 major redemption prizes.

### REDEMPTION SYSTEM

The website needs a **REDEEM YOUR PRIZE** page.

Customer enters their unique code.

If the code is valid:

* The website reveals the specific prize assigned to that code.
* It displays the actual photos, artist name, description and authentication information.
* Customer enters their name, email, phone number and shipping address.
* Customer submits their claim.
* I receive the customer's claim/shipping information.
* The code is permanently marked **REDEEMED** and cannot be used again.

If an invalid code is entered, it should say the code is invalid.

items.description:
# AI Developer Needed: Google Drive Integration, File Analysis and Dashboard

I am looking for an experienced **AI Integration Developer or AI Solutions Engineer** to build a secure system connecting a private Google Drive repository with artificial intelligence, automated reporting, AI chat and a live dashboard.

The developer must have proven technical experience integrating AI with Google Drive. Detailed business rules and confidential documents will be shared only with the selected candidate.

## Required Workflow

**Google Drive → Automatic File Detection → AI Analysis → Generated Report → AI Chat → Live Dashboard**

## Core Requirements

The system must:

* Connect securely to selected Google Drive folders and subfolders.
* Monitor existing, new and updated files.
* Detect uploaded, modified, renamed, moved and deleted files.
* Process files automatically without manual uploading.
* Read PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and scanned documents.
* Extract text, tables, numbers and relevant metadata.
* Analyze every new or updated file using configurable review criteria.
* Compare the file with related documents when available.
* Identify missing, conflicting, duplicated or outdated information.
* Highlight key findings, gaps, risks and required actions.
* Generate a standardized report for every analyzed file.
* Provide source citations for important AI findings.
* Update a live dashboard automatically.
* Allow users to ask questions through an AI chat interface.
* Maintain a complete audit log.

## Google Drive Integration

The solution must use the official Google Drive API and support:

* Google OAuth 2.0 or service-account authentication.
* Access limited to approved folders.
* Initial indexing of existing files.
* Incremental synchronization.
* Google Drive Changes API.
* Push notifications, events or webhooks where appropriate.
* File-version and modification tracking.
* Automatic retries after synchronization failures.
* Prevention of duplicate file processing.
* Secure storage of credentials and access tokens.

The system must not depend on browser automation, repeated full downloads or manual file transfers.

The developer must recommend whether OAuth 2.0 or a service account is more appropriate and explain why.

## AI File Analysis

For each new or updated file, the AI must:

* Retrieve and analyze the latest authorized version.
* Identify the document type, date, subject and owner when available.
* Extract important information and structured fields.
* Apply predefined business rules and review criteria.
* Assess document completeness and consistency.
* Compare the file with relevant existing files.
* Detect missing information and supporting documents.
* Identify inconsistencies, risks and warning indicators.
* Recommend corrective actions.
* Separate confirmed facts from AI observations.
* Provide a confidence level for AI-generated findings.
* Cite the supporting file, page, section, sheet or cell.
* State “Not Available” or “Not Evidenced” when information is missing.
* Avoid inventing unsupported information.

The analysis criteria must be configurable without rebuilding the system.

## Automated Analysis Report

The system must generate a report containing:

1. File name, type and folder.
2. Upload and modification dates.
3. Executive summary.
4. Key extracted information.
5. Completeness assessment.
6. Missing information.
7. Conflicts or outdated information.
8. Identified risks and warning indicators.
9. Recommended corrective actions.
10. Responsible owner when identified.
11. Source references.
12. AI confidence level.
13. Overall review status.
14. Items requiring human review.

The report must be:

* Linked to the original file.
* Available through the dashboard.
* Searchable through AI chat.
* Exportable to PDF and Excel.
* Updated when the source file changes.
* Recorded in the audit log.

## AI Chat

Authorized users must be able to ask questions such as:

* What files were uploaded or updated today?
* What did the AI identify in the latest file?
* Which files contain missing information?
* What risks or inconsistencies were detected?
* What changed between two file versions?
* Which documents require human review?
* Show the source supporting this finding.
* Generate a summary for a selected folder or period.

Answers must use authorized information, cite supporting sources, respect access permissions and clearly state when information is unavailable.

## Live Dashboard

The dashboard must show:

* Total monitored files.
* New and updated files.
* Analysis status.
* Files requiring human review.
* Missing information.
* Key risks and findings.
* Recommended actions.
* Generated reports.
* Synchronization failures.
* Last successful synchronization and refresh.

Filters should include folder, file type, date, review status, risk level, owner and AI confidence level.

Users must be able to open the relevant source file and generated report from the dashboard.

## Notifications

Notify authorized users when:

* A file is uploaded or updated.
* AI analysis is completed.
* A critical gap or risk is identified.
* Human review is required.
* A report is ready.
* Google Drive synchronization fails.

## Security and Governance

The solution must include:

* Role-based access control.
* Minimum necessary Google Drive permissions.
* Secure API-key and OAuth-token management.
* Encryption in transit and at rest.
* No public exposure of source documents.
* User-access and system-activity logs.
* Backup and recovery procedures.
* Separation of testing and production environments.
* Clear disclosure of where documents and extracted data are processed and stored.
* No use of confidential files for model training without authorization.

The AI must never automatically approve documents, delete or modify source files, make final decisions or present predictions as confirmed facts.

## Required Experience

Applicants must demonstrate experience with:

* Google Drive API.
* OAuth 2.0 and service accounts.
* Google Drive Changes API and webhooks.
* OpenAI API and Responses API.
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* Function calling and Structured Outputs.
* Vector databases or semantic search.
* PDF, DOCX, XLSX and PPTX processing.
* OCR and table extraction.
* Backend and database development.
* Dashboard development.
* Scheduled background jobs.
* Security, audit logging and cloud deployment.

## Expected Deliverables

1. Technical architecture and data-flow diagram.
2. Secure Google Drive integration.
3. Automatic file-change detection.
4. Document extraction pipeline.
5. AI analysis engine.
6. Configurable analysis rules.
7. Structured database.
8. Automated analysis reports.
9. AI chat interface with source citations.
10. Live dashboard and notifications.
11. Audit logs and access control.
12. Testing and production deployment.
13. Full source code and documentation.
14. Administrator training.
15. Warranty and post-deployment support.

## Proof of Concept

The project must begin with a proof of concept demonstrating:

1. Secure connection to a test Google Drive folder.
2. Automatic detection of an uploaded or updated file.
3. Extraction and AI analysis of the file.
4. Comparison with a related file.
5. Generation of a cited review report.
6. Automatic dashboard update.
7. AI follow-up questions.
8. Complete audit logging.

Full implementation will proceed after successful approval of the proof of concept.

## Proposal Requirements

Please provide:

* Examples of similar AI and Google Drive integrations.
* Proposed technology stack and architecture.
* Authentication and security approach.
* File-change detection method.
* Document extraction and AI-analysis approach.
* Method for providing accurate source citations.
* Proof-of-concept timeline and cost.
* Full implementation timeline and cost.
* Estimated recurring hosting and API costs.
* Support and maintenance terms.
* Confirmation of source-code ownership and handover.

## Screening Questions

1. Describe a previous AI system you connected to Google Drive.
2. How will you detect new, updated, moved and deleted files?
3. Would you use OAuth 2.0 or a service account, and why?
4. How will the AI analyze different file formats automatically?
5. How will you ensure each finding cites the correct source?
6. How will you prevent duplicate processing?
7. How will you protect confidential documents and credentials?
8. What will you demonstrate in the proof of concept?

I am not looking for only a dashboard designer, prompt writer or basic ChatGPT user. I need a developer with proven experience in:

**Google Drive Integration + Automated File Monitoring + AI Document Analysis + Automated Reports + AI Chat + Live Dashboard**

Generic proposals without clear technical answers or relevant examples will not be considered.

Skills: OCR, Word Processing, Database Development, Data Extraction, Backend Development, AI Chatbot Development, Vector Databases, AI Integration

items.description:
B2B Cold Caller & Appointment Setter

Commission-Only | Remote | Zyvanta Digital

Company: Zyvanta Digital
Role: B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter
Location: Remote / Work From Home
Calling Days: Monday–Friday
Permitted Calling Window: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM
Pay: Commission Only — 30% per confirmed deal

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for experienced B2B sales professionals, cold callers and appointment setters to join Zyvanta Digital on a commission-only basis.

Your role is straightforward: make outbound calls to businesses, introduce Zyvanta Digital, identify potential opportunities and book qualified demonstrations for our owners to conduct.

You will not be expected to conduct the sales meetings yourself. Once you've successfully booked an appointment, the Zyvanta owners will take over the demonstration and closing process.

If the prospect becomes a confirmed customer, you receive 30% commission on the deal.

CALLING EXPECTATIONS

Calls can be made Monday to Friday between 9:00 AM and 6:00 PM.

9am–6pm is the permitted calling window, not fixed working hours.

We are not measuring or paying based on hours worked. We care about activity, conversations, appointments and ultimately results.

Our starting performance benchmark is an average of approximately 50 outbound calls per day.

This is an average target rather than a strict hourly quota. Some days may involve more calls, while others may involve longer conversations, follow-ups or booked appointments.

The principle is simple:

The more quality calls you make, the more opportunities you create.

High performers who consistently exceed the starting target will naturally create more opportunities to earn commission.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

You will:

• Make B2B cold calls
• Use leads provided by Zyvanta Digital
• Source your own prospects where appropriate
• Speak with business owners and decision-makers
• Introduce our website and CRM solutions
• Identify businesses that could benefit from our services
• Qualify interested prospects
• Handle common objections
• Build rapport and create interest
• Book qualified demonstrations
• Record relevant prospect information
• Follow up with prospects where appropriate

You book the appointment — we conduct the meeting and handle the close.

COMMISSION

This is a commission-only position.

You receive 30% commission on every confirmed deal that you generate and which is successfully signed and confirmed by Zyvanta Digital.

Example 1 — 12-Month Contract

Customer signs for:

£75/month × 12 months = £900 total contract value

Your commission:

30% = £270

The £270 commission is paid in monthly instalments alongside the customer's payments.

Example 2 — 24-Month Contract

Customer signs for:

£65/month × 24 months = £1,560 total contract value

Your commission:

30% = £468

Again, this is paid in monthly instalments alongside the customer's payments.

As Zyvanta is a growing business, this structure allows us to manage cash flow responsibly. As we scale, we intend to introduce additional incentives and improved commission structures for high-performing salespeople who consistently generate multiple deals.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for people with existing experience in:

• B2B sales
• Cold calling
• Appointment setting
• Telemarketing
• Lead generation
• Business development
• Speaking with business owners
• Handling objections
• Converting conversations into appointments
• Fluent English speaking

Previous sales experience is strongly preferred.

You should be confident, resilient, self-motivated and comfortable picking up the phone and speaking to businesses you've never contacted before.

KEY SKILLS

Communication — Fluent spoken English and professional communication are essential.

Confidence — Comfortable approaching business owners and decision-makers.

Persuasion — Able to communicate value without being overly pushy.

Objection Handling — Comfortable responding to common objections and keeping conversations productive.

Resilience — Able to handle rejection and move confidently onto the next opportunity.

Organisation — Able to keep track of prospects, follow-ups and appointments.

Self-Motivation — Able to work independently without constant supervision.

REMOTE WORKING

This is a fully remote work-from-home position

You can organise your own calling schedule during the permitted 9am–6pm Monday–Friday calling window, provided you are consistently making calls and working towards the expected average of approximately 50 calls per day.

There is currently no fixed number of hours you are required to work each day.

We are focused on performance rather than clocking hours.

You will need:

• Reliable internet
• Computer/laptop
• Suitable headset/microphone
• Quiet environment for professional calls
• Ability to make outbound calls
• Good organisational skills
• Able to contact UK numbers (+44)

Zyvanta will provide the leads, service information, scripts, training, guidance and resources needed to get started.

OPPORTUNITY TO GROW

Zyvanta Digital is still growing, and we're building the foundations of a much larger company.

As we expand, we're planning opportunities across:

• Sales
• Senior Sales
• Sales Management
• Business Development
• Account Management
• Recruitment
• Recruitment Management
• Lead Generation
• Strategic Business Services

High-performing individuals will have the opportunity to take on greater responsibility and potentially progress into senior positions as the company expands.

We're looking for people who want to grow with Zyvanta, not simply make a few sales and move on.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We're giving experienced salespeople the opportunity to focus on what they do best:

Make the calls.

Start the conversations.

Book the meetings.

We handle the demonstrations and closing.

You earn 30% of every confirmed deal you generate.

If you're confident on the phone, experienced in B2B sales and motivated by performance-based earning, we want to hear from you.

• Assemble the complete, city-ready submittal package—checklists, forms, digital files, and a stamped PDF—so it can be uploaded to the City of Dallas permitting portal without further edits on my end.

Every element—the typography, gold arch, handbag illustration, and decorative flourishes—must match the reference pixel-for-pixel in proportion, placement, colour, and overall balance. Because the logo is to remain unchanged, do not introduce new fonts or stylistic tweaks. Instead, recreate the current letterforms manually (or by matching them as closely as possible to an available typeface and then adjusting outlines so they look identical).

• A print-ready PDF and an RGB SVG for web use

items.title: Sports Speaker Bureau Website + AI Editorial Build
items.description:
Sports speaker bureau website rebuild or extension, with an AI-assisted content and speaker-management layer. This is a competitive RFP — a full 16-section written RFP is available on request.

WHO WE ARE
A US sports speaker bureau. We represent a large roster of professional and Olympic athletes and book them for corporate events, conferences, fundraisers and campus appearances. Our current public site runs on Strapi (Node).

PRICE BOTH OF THESE SEPARATELY
Option A — Extend the existing Strapi build: keep the CMS and content model, improve the front end, information architecture, SEO and speaker-management workflow, and add the AI layer.
Option B — Greenfield rebuild on a stack you recommend and can justify, with full content migration.
Bids that price only one option will not be evaluated. 

MANDATORY — THIS IS AN ELIGIBILITY GATE
The AI content and speaker-management layer is not an optional add-on. If you cannot deliver it, please do not bid. Answer these five questions directly in your bid:
1. Accuracy — how do you prevent fabricated biographical facts about a real person? What is your grounding approach?
2. Human review — what is the exact editorial workflow between generation and publication, and where does approval live in the CMS?
3. Rights and likeness — how do you handle image rights, photo credits and athlete approval of copy written about them?
4. Model provider — which provider(s), what happens to our content, and can we switch later without a rewrite?
5. Error handling — what happens when the model is unavailable, rate-limited, or returns something unusable mid-publish?

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
- SEO is a primary business driver. Documented URL redirect map from the existing site, preserved rankings on our highest-traffic pages, structured data for people and events, per-page metadata control, working XML sitemap.
- Inquiry and booking forms integrate with our CRM. We are on GoHighLevel and evaluating HubSpot — handle either, and say what changes if we switch.
- WCAG 2.1 AA as a delivery requirement, not later remediation.
- Stated performance budgets and Core Web Vitals targets, tested before handover.
- First-party event tracking plus GA4.

OWNERSHIP AND RUN COSTS
- We own the source code outright at completion. No proprietary CMS we cannot leave.
- Handover includes documented local dev setup, deployment runbook and a working staging environment.
- Itemise ongoing monthly run costs separately from build cost: hosting, any CMS licence, AI/model usage at our expected volume, search, email, monitoring.
- Quote maintenance and support separately: response times, what is included, what is billed.

BUDGET
Maximum US $20,000 for the build. Propose your own milestone schedule with deliverables tied to payments.

INCLUDE IN YOUR BID
Two prices (A and B) and what differs; answers to the five AI questions; two or three live content-heavy, people-driven sites you built and your specific role on each; one SEO-preserving migration you ran and what traffic did afterwards; itemised monthly run costs; team composition and who we talk to weekly; timeline with milestones.

Copy-paste boilerplate bids will be ignored. We read every bid that engages with the questions above.

I manage a local football players' WhatsApp group based in **Rolla, Sharjah**, created for people who enjoy playing football and are looking to join regular games in the local area.

We are looking for a **freelance social media and community marketing specialist** to promote the group and attract more genuine, active football players from Rolla and surrounding areas of Sharjah.

### Main Objective

The primary responsibility will be to increase the number of **genuine football players joining our WhatsApp group**.

The goal is not simply to increase the WhatsApp member count, but to build an active local football community.

### Target Audience

The campaign should focus on football players located in:

* Rolla
* Al Ghuwair
* Al Nabba
* Al Qasimia
* Al Mahatta
* Al Yarmook
* Al Sharq
* Al Majaz
* Abu Shagara
* Other nearby areas of Sharjah

The freelancer should also identify additional locations and communities where potential players can be reached.

#### 1. Local Football Audience Research

Identify where football players in Rolla and Sharjah can be reached, including:

* Facebook groups
* Instagram pages and communities
* TikTok
* Local sports communities
* WhatsApp communities where promotion is permitted
* Telegram groups
* Reddit and other relevant community forums
* Local football pages
* Sports centres and football communities

#### 2. Social Media Promotion

Create and promote attractive content for the football group, including:

* Instagram posts
* Instagram Reels
* Facebook posts
* WhatsApp Status creatives
* Digital posters
* Short promotional videos
* Player recruitment posts
* Match announcements

#### 3. WhatsApp Group Growth

Develop an effective strategy to convert interested football players into WhatsApp group members.

The freelancer should track:

**Promotion → Enquiry → Group Join → Active Player**

### Content Direction

The promotional message should be simple, professional and locally targeted.

Example:

**FOOTBALL PLAYERS IN ROLLA & SHARJAH**

Looking for people to play football with?

Join our local football community to:

* Find football games
* Meet local players
* Join available matches
* Find players and substitutes

**Rolla | Sharjah**

**Join the Football Community Today**

The freelancer is encouraged to suggest improved slogans, designs and promotional concepts.

* Fake accounts
* Bots

The freelancer should provide:

* Marketing strategy
* Social media promotional content
* Digital posters and creatives
* Social media posts
* Recommended local promotion channels
* WhatsApp group growth strategy
* Weekly performance report

### Performance Measurement

Success will be measured by:

* Number of genuine new members
* Number of players from Rolla and Sharjah

* Group engagement
* Number of players participating in games
* Cost per genuine member, where paid advertising is used

**Quality and active participation are more important than member numbers.**

* Social media marketing
* Local marketing
* Community building
* WhatsApp group promotion
* Instagram and Facebook marketing
* Lead generation
* Sports marketing

Experience promoting football groups, sports communities, gyms, local events or recreational activities is preferred.

7. Your fee.
8. Any recommended advertising budget.
9. Examples of promotional content you have created.
10. How you will ensure that members are genuine and relevant.

### Project Type

**Freelance – Initial Trial Campaign**

A successful freelancer may be retained for ongoing promotion and community management.

### Key Goal

> **Make our Rolla football WhatsApp group the go-to local community for people looking to play football in Rolla and nearby areas of Sharjah.**

**ROLLA, SHARJAH**
**Find Players. Join Games. Play Football.**

items.title: Apartment Floor Plan Renovation Concept
items.description:
I am considering buying an apartment with the attached floor plan, but before making a decision, I would like to explore different layout and renovation possibilities.

The main issues with the current layout are:

* The kitchen at the top of the floor plan is very long and narrow.
* One bedroom has direct access to a bathroom, while the bathroom intended for all other occupants is windowless.
* Overall, I would like to redesign the layout to make the apartment more functional and modern.

I am looking for creative alternative floor plan solutions. These are some of my initial ideas:

**Option 1:**
Create an open-plan living area with the kitchen located where the current master bedroom is. Convert the current long kitchen area into a bathroom, using the long and narrow upper section for the shower. I would keep only one bedroom. I would also like suggestions on what to do with the existing windowless bathroom.

**Option 2:**
Keep the existing long kitchen in its current location and create an open-plan living area with both a TV/lounge area and a dining area. Keep both the windowed bathroom and the windowless bathroom. This would probably be the least expensive option in terms of renovation costs.

**Option 3:**
Create an open-plan living area with the kitchen located where the current master bedroom is. In the upper part of the apartment, create two bedrooms, with one of them potentially being smaller and also suitable as a home office. One of the bedrooms could have an en-suite bathroom, using the narrow section for the shower area.

These are just initial ideas, and I am open to other creative solutions. I would like the freelancer to analyze the existing floor plan and propose alternative layouts that make the best possible use of the available space.

The goal is to have a modern, functional, and well-organized apartment while considering the practicality and potential cost of the renovation.

FINAL CONTINUATION — AI VIRTUAL EXPERIENCE CREATOR + FANVUE GROWTH PARTNER

This is the third and final continuation of my original job posts. Think of this as the final screening/interview.

If you applied before, please read this carefully. If this makes you MORE interested, contact me. If you cannot genuinely produce this level of work, please do not apply.

THIS IS AN EXPERIENCE — NOT A NORMAL FANVUE/ONLYFANS PAGE

I am building a high-end immersive virtual gentlemen’s-club experience, not a basic page selling random photos and videos.

Members should feel like they are actually entering a real luxury club, getting to know the woman at the center of it, progressing through different rooms and unlocking increasingly exclusive experiences.

The customer should constantly think: “What happens in the next room?”

WHO I AM / WHO SHE IS

The AI woman is based on ME — my likeness, personality and presence.

I am a model developing a supermodel-style AI twin based on myself. I am also a businesswoman running other companies and studying law.

She is beautiful and glamorous, but also smart, strong, sophisticated, confident, caring, understanding and flirtatious.

Members should feel that they actually get to know her. Some may be businessmen, executives, entrepreneurs or wealthy clients who have stressful days and simply want somewhere luxurious to unwind, have a drink, talk, flirt and relax.

The connection matters just as much as the visual experience.

THE ROOMS / PROGRESSION

$100 — THE LOUNGE + BAR

This is where members enter and begin getting to know her. Think beautiful luxury lounge/bar, drinks, conversation and flirting.

I already have still-image concepts showing her sitting at a bar with a gentleman naturally seen from behind in a suit, with other guests subtly in the background.

The viewer must feel HE IS ACTUALLY IN THE ROOM WITH HER, not looking at an AI woman placed in front of a fake background.

Around $250 — THE TEASE / ENTERTAINMENT ROOM

More playful and seductive while still maintaining the connection. Dancing, teasing, flirting, drinks and entertainment. This may include pole-dance-style and belly-dance entertainment.

THE CIGAR LOUNGE

Sophisticated, intimate, darker luxury atmosphere with drinks and the feeling of a private high-end club.

THE DANCE / POLE / ENTERTAINMENT EXPERIENCE

Realistic AI-human movement and video — not just still pictures.

THE BUBBLE ROOM

A more exclusive champagne/bubble-bath atmosphere where members feel they have been invited somewhere more private.

THE PURPLE RAIN / VICHY SHOWER ROOM

A signature premium experience with water, movement, beautiful lighting and cinematic atmosphere.

There will be additional premium rooms and concepts shared only with the person selected.

Every room must feel like part of ONE REAL CLUB. The architecture, lighting, atmosphere and character must remain consistent. We may use immersive/POV-style perspectives, background guests and adult male guests naturally seen from behind or in silhouette so the member feels physically present.

MEMBERSHIP / STATUS PROGRESSION

The customer journey is approximately:

$100 → $250 → $500 → $1,000 → $1,500 SUGAR DADDY STATUS

Fanvue has platform pricing limits, so higher spending levels may use membership plus premium/PPV experiences.

Someone who can comfortably afford $100 should be able to enter and then WANT to see what the $250 experience unlocks, then the next level.

At the highest end, Sugar Daddy Status is intended for affluent/high-net-worth clientele, potentially including multimillionaire-level customers who can comfortably afford a highly exclusive premium monthly experience.

They are NOT paying more simply to receive more pictures.

They are paying to unlock a deeper level of the EXPERIENCE.

THIS IS NOT A 1–7 DAY PROJECT

I keep seeing bids saying 1 day, 3 days or 7 days.

That is NOT how this works.

Yes, I need someone FAST. I want enough of the first experience built within the next few weeks to begin accepting approximately $100 memberships within one month maximum.

Ideally, we launch the first level while already building the $250 experience behind it.

But the work continues indefinitely. Members cannot receive the same content every month.

We will continually need new videos, scenes, outfits, conversations, entertainment, special events, premium experiences, social content and eventually additional rooms.

More content = more work = more milestones = continued paid work.

HOW MILESTONES WILL WORK

Finalists may first receive a small $10 PAID TEST.

Then we will test the waters during the first few working stages.

For example, I may tell you:

“The first room is The Lounge. This is the experience I want. Tell me how YOU would bring it to life.”

I will give you the vision. I need YOU to know how to execute it.

I will be evaluating:

quality, realism, creativity, speed, how much meaningful work you deliver, communication, reliability and how independently you work.

How you perform during those first stages will help determine the pace, frequency, scope and value of future milestones as we continue.

I am NOT paying separately for every picture, video or individual scene. We will work through meaningful development/content milestones.

As I see how you work and what you deliver, we can increase the pace and value of milestone work. Substantial milestone work will be agreed before each next phase begins.

If you are excellent:

Build → approve → next room → next milestone → launch → more content → grow → continue.

BONUSES + COMMISSIONS

I reward excellent work. If I see exceptional quality, initiative, reliability and someone genuinely helping make this vision successful, I also give performance bonuses at my discretion.

The bigger additional earning opportunity comes from social-media growth and paying memberships.

I need someone who can create social content that makes people stop and think:

I want real paying customers, not fake followers.

There will be commissions tied to verified paying members you help generate.

For example:

10 new verified $100 members = commission opportunity.

Another 10 = another commission opportunity.

And higher-value customers create greater commission opportunities. Successfully helping bring members into approximately $250, $500, $1,000 and ultimately $1,500 Sugar Daddy experiences obviously creates substantially more value.

Exact commissions will be discussed with the person selected once we begin working together and see actual results.

The more this business grows, the greater the earning opportunity for the person helping me build and grow it.

I WILL NOT TRAIN OR BABYSIT

I am a busy businesswoman running other companies and managing multiple responsibilities.

I do not have time to train, babysit, micromanage or hold someone’s hand.

I will tell you the room, the feeling and what I want the member to experience.

You need to already know how to make it happen professionally.

I absolutely welcome strong ideas that could make this more immersive, exciting, profitable or unique. I want somebody who contributes ideas and solutions — not another job for me to manage.

SHOW ME RELEVANT WORK ONLY

Please do NOT send random websites, logos, cartoons or unrelated portfolios.

FINAL QUESTIONS

items.title: Sales Forecasting Expert
items.description:
Project Objective: 

(please do not apply if you do not have any experience in Finance, Data analitycs. AI users won’t ve hired)

I'm looking for an experienced freelance financial / retail forecasting specialist with excellent Excel skills to develop a fully automated Sales Forecasting & Target Setting Model.

The objective is to create a reliable tool that can:

- Predict the expected sales landing based on actual performance.

- Recommend whether the current sales target should be revised upward or downward and why

- Build different business scenarios to support decision-making 

- Automatically update forecasts as new weekly sales results are added.

- Provide forecasting at both total business and detailed product level.



Required Expertise

The freelancer should have strong experience in:

- Financial forecasting and modelling.

- Retail sales planning and target setting.

- Sales trend and performance analysis.

- Predictive modelling.

- Scenario planning.

- Advanced Excel modelling and automation.

- Large datasets with multiple dimensions.

- Value and quantity analysis.

- Seasonality and historical trend analysis.



Experience in retail, FMCG or another product-driven business would be highly preferred.

Data Available

Historical and current sales data will be provided including:

* Sales Value.

* Sales Quantity.

* Weekly performance.

* Monthly performance.

* Fiscal Year performance.

* Previous-year comparison.

* by Segment.

* by Product Line.



The model should be designed so additional historical variables can be incorporated where relevant to improve forecasting accuracy.

Required Sales Forecast

The model must calculate an expected sales landing for each period based on actual performance to date.

Forecasts will be required at:

- Total Business level.

- By Segment.

- Total of all Segments.

- By Product Line.

- Total of all Product Lines.

- Sales Value.

- Sales Quantity.



The model must allow the user to move easily from the total business view into the Segment and Product Line details.



Scenario Planning

The model should calculate four scenarios:

- Pessimistic: downside scenario based on weaker expected performance.

- Realistic Landing: statistically most probable expected result based on current performance and historical behaviour.

- Stretch Target: achievable target above the realistic landing requiring additional business acceleration.

- Optimistic: upper potential scenario based on favourable performance assumptions.

The scenarios should not simply apply arbitrary percentage increases or decreases to the same forecast.

Each scenario must have a clear methodology and business rationale 

Landing & Target Recommendation

A critical part of the project is the development of an equation/model able to estimate the expected landing during the month or fiscal period.

The calculation should consider, where statistically relevant:

* Actual sales achieved to date.

* Remaining selling days / weeks.

* Historical weekly sales distribution.

* Historical monthly performance.

* Same period previous year.

* Current growth / decline trend.

* Recent sales velocity.

* Value and quantity trends.

* Segment performance.

* Product Line performance.

* Seasonality.

* Historical acceleration or slowdown during different stages of the month.

* Current target achievement.

* Other statistically relevant variables identified by the expert.

The model should then identify:

Current Target → Expected Landing → Gap / Upside → Recommended Revised Target

It should clearly indicate when the existing target appears:

* Too low.

* Realistic.

* At risk.

* Too aggressive.



Forecasting Methodology



This is one of the most important requirements of the project.

I'm not looking for a generic run-rate calculation, such as:

Sales achieved ÷ days elapsed × total days

I'm also not looking for an automatically generated formula without a strong financial or statistical rationale.

The freelancer is expected to design and recommend the appropriate forecasting methodology based on the available data.

The methodology may combine several forecasting approaches if this improves accuracy.

The expert must provide a detailed explanation covering:

- The forecasting equation.

- Why this methodology was selected.

- Variables included in the calculation.

- Weight given to each variable.

- How the weights were determined.

- Treatment of seasonality.

- Treatment of abnormal sales periods or outliers.

- How weekly performance impacts the forecast.

-  How Value and Quantity interact within the forecast.

- How each scenario is calculated.

- How the Stretch Target is calculated.

- How and when the target should be revised upward or downward.

- Limitations of the forecasting methodology.

Accuracy & Back-Testing

The model must be tested against historical sales data before final validation.

The freelancer should calculate the forecast error and demonstrate how accurate the methodology would historically have been.

The final methodology should be selected based on measured forecasting accuracy, not only theoretical assumptions.

Excel Tool Requirements

The final Excel file should be:

- Fully automated.

- Easy to update.

- Easy to understand.

- Structured for recurring monthly use.

- Able to integrate new weekly results without rebuilding calculations.

- Able to automatically refresh forecasts and scenarios.

- Able to automatically calculate target gaps and recommended target revisions.

- Equipped with clear input, calculation and output sections.

- Protected against accidental formula changes where relevant.

- Designed so the methodology can be audited and understood.

No manual calculation should be required for the regular forecasting process once the model is finalized.

Expected Deliverables

The final delivery must include:

- Fully functional automated Excel forecasting model.

- Sales landing forecast.

- Four scenario calculations.

- Target revision recommendation.

- Segment-level forecast.

- Product Line-level forecast.

- Total business forecast.

- Value and Quantity forecasting.

- Historical back-testing results.

- Forecast accuracy / error analysis.

- Full explanation of the forecasting methodology.

- Detailed explanation of every major equation and assumption.

- User guide explaining how to update and use the model.



Important

I'm specifically looking for someone with genuine financial forecasting and retail modelling expertise, not only advanced Excel skills.

The objective is not to create a visually impressive spreadsheet. The priority is to develop a robust, explainable and historically tested forecasting methodology that can support commercial decisions and improve the accuracy of sales target setting.

items.title: YouTube Thumbnail Creator
items.description:
I publish regular content on YouTube and need thumbnails that feel professional, minimalist, and instantly legible even on a phone screen. For every video, I want two to three distinctly different concepts, each followed by a couple of small tweaks so we can A/B test which variation earns the stronger click-through rate.  

Here’s the workflow I have in mind:  
• You deliver the concepts, source files (PSD or AI), and correctly sized PNG exports.  
• I rotate each version for at least two days. If a thumbnail scores below a 5.5 % CTR, we adjust or move to a fresh concept—always within a two-week iteration window.  
• While monitoring CTR, you also keep an eye on average view duration and the first-three-minute retention curve. If the numbers hint that the visual promise of the thumbnail isn’t fulfilled early in the video, flag it so we can realign expectations.  

Title ideas and any overlay copy that strengthens the thumbnail’s hook should come packaged with each set. Clean typography, strong contrast, and plenty of negative space are essential; clutter, comedy graphics, and heavy textures are not a fit for this channel.  

By the end of each cycle I should have:  
1. 2-3 unique thumbnail designs + minor A/B variations  
2. A short line explaining why each concept should resonate with the target viewer  
3. Source files and final exports ready to upload  

If this systematic, data-driven approach to minimalist thumbnail design sounds like your wheelhouse, let’s start on the next upload.

items.title: Portrait Skin Tone Correction
items.description:
I have a set of portrait images that look flat and a little off-color straight out of the camera, and I want them to feel vibrant yet true to life. The sole objective is to enhance natural skin tones so the subjects look healthy and well-lit without crossing into an over-processed or stylised look.

To make this happen, I will need you to work directly on the RAW or high-resolution JPEG files (whichever you prefer in your workflow) and apply the following targeted corrections:  
• Brightness and contrast adjustments  
• Removing any colour casts that shift the skin away from a natural hue  
• Fine-tuning highlights and shadows for balanced depth across the face and background  

Please preserve texture and avoid aggressive smoothing; I’m aiming for clean editorial portraits, not beauty retouching. Colour accuracy across different monitors is important, so a calibrated workflow in Lightroom, Capture One, or Photoshop is welcome.

Deliverables are the final colour-corrected, full-resolution files plus a brief note on the steps or settings you used so I can keep the look consistent in future shoots. If this sounds straightforward in your toolkit, I’m ready to send the images right away.

Skills: Photography, Photoshop, Photo Editing, Photoshop Design, Visual Arts, Image Processing, Photo Retouching, Adobe Photoshop

The project must be completed **end-to-end and published on both Google Play and Apple App Store**.

items.title: Senior Data Acquisition & Document Intelligence Engineer
items.description:
Project Title: Senior Data Acquisition & Document Intelligence Engineer

We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Data Acquisition & Document Intelligence Engineer to build, operate, and continuously improve a large-scale production data acquisition and document processing system.

Project Type: Long-term / Ongoing
Engagement: Full-time
Experience Required: 5+ years
Location: On-site / Hybrid

About the Project

We collect large volumes of publicly available documents and structured records from hundreds of external web sources every day.

The sources are highly inconsistent and frequently change their website structure, formats, URLs, APIs, and document layouts. A significant portion of the data also comes from scanned PDFs, images, and other difficult-to-process documents.

We need someone who can take end-to-end ownership of the entire data acquisition pipeline, including web scraping, crawling, document downloading, OCR, data extraction, structuring, validation, quality assurance, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance.

This is not a one-time scraping project. We are looking for someone with proven experience building and maintaining production-grade extraction pipelines at scale.

Key Responsibilities

1. Web Scraping & Data Acquisition

Build and maintain large-scale crawlers across hundreds of websites and external data sources.
Handle dynamic websites, JavaScript rendering, pagination, sessions, cookies, tokens, forms, and file downloads.
Work with technologies such as Python, Scrapy, Playwright, Selenium, Puppeteer, Requests/httpx, etc.
Implement rate limiting, retries, backoff, and request management.
Build incremental crawling and change-detection mechanisms.
Detect website/source changes and quickly fix broken extractors.
Ensure data is collected completely, accurately, and on schedule.

2. OCR & Document Processing

Process large volumes of native PDFs, scanned PDFs, images, and other document formats.
Build and optimize OCR pipelines for poor-quality documents.
Handle skewed/rotated pages, faded text, stamps, seals, watermarks, handwriting, and complex layouts.
Apply image preprocessing such as deskewing, denoising, binarization, cropping, and image enhancement.
Extract structured information from complex tables, including merged cells, multi-page tables, borderless tables, and nested headers.
Process multilingual documents, including Indian regional languages.
Benchmark and select appropriate OCR engines based on document type and accuracy.

3. Data Extraction & Structuring

Convert unstructured web/document content into structured datasets.
Design and maintain data schemas.
Use rules, regex, layout-aware extraction, NLP/NER, and LLM-assisted extraction where appropriate.
Normalize dates, amounts, units, names, addresses, identifiers, and other inconsistent values.
Implement deduplication and entity resolution.
Maintain taxonomies, classification logic, and reference/master data.

4. Data Quality & Validation

Build automated quality checks for completeness, accuracy, freshness, consistency, uniqueness, and validity.
Implement validation and anomaly-detection mechanisms.
Maintain gold-standard datasets and benchmark extraction/OCR accuracy.
Create human-in-the-loop review processes for low-confidence results.
Reconcile extracted data against the original source.
Maintain data lineage and audit trails so records can be traced back to the original source document and extraction run.

5. Production Operations

Build and operate reliable, scheduled production pipelines.
Use Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or similar orchestration tools.
Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, retries, and failure recovery.
Track uptime, throughput, latency, coverage, cost, and data quality.
Use Docker and CI/CD.
Troubleshoot production issues and prevent recurring failures.
Document the system, extraction logic, and operational procedures.
Must-Have Skills
5+ years of hands-on experience in production data extraction, web scraping, document processing, or data acquisition.
Strong Python programming and production engineering practices.
Strong experience with large-scale web scraping/crawling.
Experience with Scrapy, Playwright, Selenium, Puppeteer, Requests/httpx, or equivalent.
Deep practical OCR experience with Tesseract, PaddleOCR, EasyOCR, Google Document AI, AWS Textract, Azure Document Intelligence, or similar.
Strong PDF/document processing experience with PyMuPDF, pdfplumber, pdfminer, Camelot, Tabula, or equivalent.
Strong SQL and relational database knowledge.
PostgreSQL or equivalent database experience.
Experience with Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or similar workflow orchestration.
Experience with AWS and/or GCP.
Experience with Docker, CI/CD, logging, monitoring, and alerting.
Strong understanding of data quality and automated testing.
Experience maintaining and improving production datasets over time.
Understanding of responsible and lawful web data collection, including robots.txt, terms of service, privacy, and applicable data protection requirements.
Good to Have
OpenCV and image processing
NLP / NER
LLM-based document extraction
Multilingual OCR
Indian regional language OCR
Entity resolution / record linkage
Data lineage and provenance
Great Expectations, Soda, Pandera, or similar
dbt and dbt tests
BigQuery
AWS S3, Lambda, Batch
GCP Cloud Storage
Distributed/batch processing
Experience with government, legal, financial, regulatory, or public-sector documents
Ideal Candidate

We are not looking for someone who has only built basic scraping scripts.

The ideal candidate should have experience operating a production system involving:

Hundreds of Sources → Crawling → Document Acquisition → OCR → Data Extraction → Structuring → Validation → QA → Production Dataset

You should understand common failure points such as website changes, broken selectors, missing documents, OCR errors, duplicate records, incorrect table extraction, silent pipeline failures, source downtime, and data quality degradation—and know how to build systems that detect and recover from these issues.

To Apply

Please send your CV along with a brief description of:

The largest scraping/document extraction pipeline you have personally managed.
Number of sources/websites handled.
Approximate daily/monthly volume of documents or records.
Types of documents processed.
Technologies and frameworks used.
Your measured OCR/extraction accuracy, if available.
How you measured and improved accuracy.
One example where a production pipeline failed silently, how you discovered it, and what you changed to prevent it from happening again.

Please provide specific numbers, technologies, and examples wherever possible. We are particularly interested in candidates with hands-on experience operating large-scale, continuously running production data acquisition systems.

Skills: Python, Data Processing, Web Scraping, OCR, Scrapy, Data Scraping, Data Extraction, Data Management, Data Engineer, OCR Automation

This is NOT a desk-research-only project.

You should be able to visit local markets, wholesalers, distributors and potential business customers and collect information directly from the market.

Initial Task – Ground Reality Market Research

The selected agent will be assigned a specific city/market and a defined research task.

Your responsibilities may include:

1. Market Mapping

Identify major T-shirt and apparel wholesale markets
Identify important retail markets
Identify wholesalers, distributors and importers
Identify promotional apparel suppliers
Identify uniform suppliers
Identify institutional apparel buyers

2. Product Research

Identify fast-moving T-shirt styles
Round-neck T-shirts
Polo T-shirts
Oversized T-shirts
Sportswear
Hoodies
Plain/basic T-shirts
School/company/uniform T-shirts

3. Standard Size and Price Research
Collect actual Size Chart and market selling prices for relevant products.

Where possible, RECORD:

Product type
Fabric composition
Approximate GSM
Quality level
Wholesale price
Retail price
Country of origin
Popular brands
Minimum order quantities

4. Buyer Research

Identify genuine potential B2B buyers such as:

Garment wholesalers
Clothing distributors
Retail chains
Apparel shops
Uniform suppliers
Schools and institutions
Corporate uniform suppliers
NGOs
Sportswear dealers

5. Ground Verification
We want real information, not copied internet data.

The agent may be required to:
Visit markets physically
Speak with sellers/buyers
Take permitted photographs of market/product displays
Collect business cards/contact details
Record WhatsApp/phone/email information
Ask basic questions about sourcing and demand
Verify whether a business is genuinely active

6. Competitor Research

Identify:
Local brands
Imported brands
Chinese suppliers
Turkish suppliers
Indian suppliers
Other major sources

Understand what products they sell and their approximate price positioning.

Required Deliverables

At the end of the task, you must provide:

Market Research Report
List of verified potential buyers
Product and price comparison
Competitor information
Photos/evidence from field visits where permitted
Contact details of relevant businesses
Key market observations
Recommendations for our 5BROS brand
Potential opportunities and challenges
Suggested next steps for entering the market

The information should be submitted in Google Sheets/Excel + a concise written report.

Important: This Is a Ground-Level Assignment

We are specifically interested in freelancers who can provide first-hand local market information.

Please do not apply if you intend to complete the entire assignment through Google, social media or online directories without visiting the market.

We want someone who can actually go PHYSICALLY into the market and tell us:

What is selling? Who is buying? At what price? From whom? What quality do they expect? And where is the opportunity for an Indian manufacturer like us?

Preferred Candidate

You should:

Be physically located in Kenya.
Have good knowledge of your local apparel market
Have experience in sales, business development or market research
Be comfortable visiting markets and businesses
Have good communication skills
Be able to communicate in English
Have a smartphone for calls, WhatsApp and photographs
Be comfortable using Google Sheets/Excel
Be honest and accurate with collected information
Be able to work independently

Previous experience in apparel, textiles, uniforms, wholesale, distribution or FMCG sales is a strong advantage.

Compensation

This is a task-based paid project.

The initial assignment will have a clearly defined scope and milestone.

We are open to discussing the budget based on:

Number of markets covered
Number of verified businesses identified
Number of field visits
Quality of research
Depth of information collected

Strong performers may be offered additional paid assignments and a longer-term Sales & Business Development role.

The long-term opportunity may involve:

Buyer development

Customer meetings
Sample coordination

Order generation

items.title: AI E-Commerce Sales Boost Platform
items.description:
My goal is to lift online revenue by building an e-commerce platform that serves each shopper a real-time, AI-driven stream of product suggestions. The entire architecture—from data ingestion to user-facing widgets—should be engineered around this single purpose: increasing sales through highly relevant recommendations.

Core functionality
The heart of the build is a personalised recommendation engine. It should analyse browsing behaviour, purchase history, and contextual signals to deliver on-page and in-email product suggestions that feel hand-picked for every visitor. While dynamic pricing and automated marketing campaigns may follow later, phase one focuses exclusively on perfecting these recommendations.

Technical expectations
•  End-to-end platform or plug-in capable of integrating with common stacks (Shopify, WooCommerce, custom React/Node, etc.).
•  Scalable data pipeline—batch and real-time—to capture events, train models, and serve predictions with low latency.
•  Model layer leveraging proven libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar) and techniques such as collaborative filtering and deep learning for cold-start mitigation.
•  Admin dashboard for A/B testing, rule overrides, and performance analytics (CTR, AOV lift, revenue attribution).

Deliverables
1. Deployed, production-ready storefront or extension with live product-suggestion widgets.
2. Source code repository with clean commit history and automated tests.
3. Infrastructure-as-code scripts (Docker/Kubernetes or equivalent) for reproducible deployment.
4. Documentation: setup guide, API spec, data schema, and a short walkthrough video.

Acceptance criteria
•  Recommendation latency under 200 ms at P95.
•  At least a 5 % uplift in click-through rate during pilot A/B test against a static control list.
•  No critical errors in load testing at 5× expected peak traffic.

Timeline is flexible within reason, provided milestones are met and performance targets are verifiable. I’m available throughout for dataset provisioning, brand assets, and iterative feedback.

 You will include in your review the name of the Museum, the location, the date of your visit- Who, What, When, Where, Why.

items.title: CE Course Approval & Compliance Coordinator -- 3
items.description:
Continuing Education Course Approval & Compliance Coordinator
Location: Remote
Must be a native English speaker from an English speaking country.
Task based
About the Role
We operate continuing education platforms serving licensees across multiple states. We're expanding into new states (Illinois, and others) and need someone to own the entire course-approval lifecycle — from identifying what we need to offer, through getting it approved by the state licensing board, building the actual course, and keeping it compliant and renewed year after year.
This is an end-to-end ownership role. You will be the single point of accountability for each state and each course offering: A to Z.
What You'll Own
Regulatory research
Research each target state's CE requirements: required topics, mandatory hour breakdowns, course categories (e.g., core/mandatory vs. elective), instructor and provider qualifications, and approval pathways.
Track the specific rules of each licensing board (e.g., Illinois, and other state real estate commissions) and translate them into a concrete plan for what we need to submit.
Application & approval
Complete and assemble provider and course approval applications for each state, including all supporting documentation (course outlines, timed agendas, learning objectives, assessments, instructor credentials, certificates of completion samples).
Submit applications, pay/track fees, and manage the back-and-forth with board reviewers — responding to deficiency notices and revision requests until approval is granted.
Course development
Develop the actual course content we'll offer for each approved topic — outlines, slides, written materials, quizzes/exams, and answer keys — built to satisfy the board's requirements and our platform's format.
Coordinate with subject-matter experts, writers, or AI-assisted content tools as needed.
Compliance & renewal
Maintain a master calendar of approval expiration dates and renewal deadlines across all states and courses.
File renewals on time, update content when regulations change, and keep all course materials and records audit-ready.
Monitor regulatory changes in active states and flag anything that affects existing offerings.
What Success Looks Like
New state offerings go from "we want to enter Illinois" to "approved and live" without items falling through the cracks.
No course ever lapses due to a missed renewal.
Applications come back approved with minimal deficiency cycles because submissions are thorough the first time.
Qualifications
Strong project management and organizational skills; comfortable owning many parallel deadlines across different jurisdictions.
Excellent written communication — you'll be drafting applications, course materials, and formal correspondence with state agencies.
Detail-oriented and comfortable reading and interpreting administrative regulations and statutes.
Self-directed; able to run a process end-to-end with minimal hand-holding.
Nice to have
Prior experience with continuing education, professional licensing, accreditation, or regulatory submissions (real estate, insurance, nursing, etc.).
Instructional design or course development background.

items.description:
Freelancer job title
U.S. Licensed Customs Broker Needed — HTS Classification & Pre-Import Compliance Review for China-to-USA Retail Kit

Job advertisement
We are a U.S. New Mexico LLC preparing our first commercial import from Qingdao, China, for sale through Amazon FBA in the United States.

We are seeking an active U.S. Customs and Border Protection licensed customs broker—not a general freight forwarder, sourcing agent, or unlicensed consultant—to provide an independent pre-import customs-compliance assessment and written HTSUS classification review.

The first shipment is complete and ready to ship. We plan to import the same product repeatedly, so we want to establish a correct, repeatable compliance process before moving the shipment and before placing future orders.

Product
The product is a sealed, retail-ready, non-food boot-care kit, labelled “Sold as Set.”

Each kit contains:

One finished solid-walnut wooden boot jack with a suede-lined heel cradle

Two finished pine-wood boot brushes

One canvas storage bag

One polyester cleaning cloth

The expected first shipment is:

Origin: Qingdao, China

Quantity: 500 retail kits

Packing: 42 master cartons

Approximate volume: 4.12 CBM

Approximate gross weight: 642 kg

Genuine supplier commercial-invoice value: USD 4,445

Destination: U.S. Amazon FBA warehouse or U.S. 3PL

Intended transport: LCL ocean freight

The manufacturer has confirmed final assembly in Shandong, China. Preliminary wood information is available, including walnut genus Juglans, confirmation that the wood is finished/bark-free, and basic factory/no-Xinjiang statements. However, scientific species, country of harvest, pine data, accessory sourcing, suede composition, and canvas fibre composition are currently incomplete. We need advice on exactly what must be obtained before shipment.

Required scope
Please provide a concise written report or memorandum, not only an HTS code, that covers:

Recommended 10-digit HTSUS classification for the complete retail kit, including analysis of whether it qualifies as a retail set and the essential-character/classification rationale.

Ordinary duty rate and all applicable China-origin tariff exposure, including relevant Chapter 99 / Section 301 treatment.

Initial AD/CVD scope screening and identification of any apparent issue.

Written determination of whether a Lacey Act declaration is likely required for the completed imported retail kit, based on the proposed HTSUS classification and current APHIS implementation schedule.

If a Lacey declaration or other wood-related requirement applies, a clear list of the exact data/documents needed from the supplier—for example, scientific genus/species, country of harvest, wood quantity, value, supplier identity, treatment/processing records, or supporting source documents.

Preliminary screening for USDA/APHIS, animal-product considerations if the suede is genuine animal material, EPA/TSCA, CPSC, country-of-origin marking, wood-packing/ISPM-15, and any other government-agency requirements that appear relevant.

Proportionate UFLPA / forced-labour risk screening and a practical list of records to retain or obtain before shipment.

A prioritised checklist separating:

Mandatory information/documents before shipment

Information recommended but not shipment-critical

Information required only if a particular classification, agency rule, examination, or CBP request applies

Identification of potential product, material, packaging, or kit-composition changes that could reduce compliance complexity or avoid an undesirable classification/tariff outcome for future production.

A concise Go / No-Go recommendation for the ready inventory, including key uncertainties or actions needed before the goods depart China.

Deliverables
Written report in English, preferably PDF or Word, approximately 2–6 pages plus any tables/checklists.

Recommended HTSUS classification with rationale.

Duty/tariff summary based on Chinese origin and declared value of USD 4,445.

Prioritised supplier-document checklist.

One 30–45 minute video/phone call to discuss findings and answer questions.

Optional separate quote for preparing a formal prospective CBP binding classification-ruling request. We are not automatically commissioning a ruling under this job.

Required qualifications
Please apply only if you can provide:

Your full legal name or brokerage firm legal name.

Your active U.S. customs broker licence number.

Your CBP permit/filer code, if applicable.

Confirmation that you are currently permitted to conduct U.S. customs business.

Experience classifying composite consumer goods, retail sets, wood products, home/gift products, footwear accessories, or similar merchandise.

Experience with China-origin tariff analysis and Lacey Act applicability.

Confirmation that you will personally perform or supervise the review.

Confirmation of whether you are willing to provide a separate quote for later entry filing, binding ruling support, or brokerage services.

Please do not apply if you cannot verify your active CBP broker credentials. We will independently verify credentials against CBP’s Permitted Customs Broker Listing before award.

Documents available
The successful applicant will receive:

Product photographs of the complete kit and individual components.

Retail-box and master-carton photos/markings.

Supplier commercial invoice and packing list/pro forma documents.

Product dimensions, weights, carton details, and quantities.

Manufacturer identity and Shandong factory address.

Existing supplier material/compliance information.

A list of unresolved supplier-information gaps.

We are looking for a practical, commercially aware expert who can distinguish between genuine legal requirements and merely “nice to have” documentation, so that we can import correctly without burdening the supplier unnecessarily.

Answer approved questions about services, prices, opening hours, and other basic information.
Collect the caller's name, phone number, email, reason for contact, and notes.
Handle appointment requests and book appointments directly into Google Calendar or another agreed calendar system.
If the caller needs something that requires a human, such as a formal quotation or a complex request, the AI should either:
perform a warm transfer to a human representative, or

Record calls and make transcripts available in the CRM.
2. WhatsApp AI Assistant

I also need a WhatsApp-based AI assistant that shares the same knowledge base and CRM as the phone assistant.

It should:

Respond to WhatsApp messages 24/7.
Understand French and Moroccan Darija.
Answer approved questions about services, prices, opening hours, etc.

Handle appointment requests.

When someone calls the business and provides a phone number, the system should be able to automatically send a WhatsApp follow-up message to that number after the call, where appropriate.

Email

Notes
Call recording

Lead status
Source/channel

Prices
Services
FAQs
Opening hours
Basic business information

The team should not need to modify code for normal content updates.

Complete phone AI receptionist
Complete WhatsApp AI assistant
Shared knowledge base
Shared CRM/database
Google Calendar integration
Phone → WhatsApp follow-up automation
Call recording and transcription
Lead/contact data extraction
Human handoff/follow-up workflow
Admin interface or simple method for updating FAQs/prices
