items.title: Desarrollo Web App con IA, Análisis de Cadena de Suministros
items.description:
DESARROLLO DE WEB APP B2B BILINGÜE CON IA, MOTOR DE REGLAS Y REPORTES EJECUTIVOS

Busco un desarrollador senior o un equipo pequeño para diseñar y construir el MVP de una Web App B2B enfocada en evaluar y priorizar oportunidades de mejora en decisiones de Supply Chain Planning.

La aplicación soportará una metodología propietaria y combinará recolección de información de varios stakeholders, evaluación de madurez, identificación de oportunidades, cálculos de valor y ROI, comparación multicriterio, análisis con inteligencia artificial, validación humana y reportes ejecutivos.

No se busca una página web, un cuestionario básico ni un chatbot genérico. Debe ser una aplicación con usuarios, organizaciones, engagements, reglas configurables, evidencia, trazabilidad y reportes.

La plataforma está abierta. Se aceptan propuestas con desarrollo tradicional, no-code, low-code o una combinación. El candidato deberá justificar su arquitectura considerando funcionalidad, seguridad, mantenimiento, escalabilidad, propiedad y costo total de operación.

ALCANCE DEL MVP

1. Diagnóstico público

Experiencia bilingüe y responsive de aproximadamente diez minutos:

• Preguntas dinámicas y lógica condicional.
• Captura de participante, empresa y consentimiento.
• Posibilidad de guardar y continuar.
• Resultado preliminar de madurez y señales de oportunidad.
• Presentación del resultado en pantalla y por correo.
• Registro del lead en el panel administrativo.
• Identificación de respuestas incompletas o inconsistentes.
• Scoring y routing interno.

El diagnóstico no produce una recomendación de inversión ni un business case completo.

2. Organizaciones, usuarios y permisos

La parte privada debe administrar organizaciones, engagements, usuarios internos y participantes del cliente. Cada engagement podrá incluir hasta cinco stakeholders.

Roles iniciales: administrador, analista interno, sponsor del cliente y stakeholder participante.

Se requiere autenticación segura, accesos según rol, asignación de secciones, guardado de avances, seguimiento de pendientes, consolidación de respuestas sin perder su fuente e historial de actividad.

3. Assessment guiado

El producto privado no será completamente self-service. El equipo interno facilitará cada engagement, cuya duración típica será cercana a dos semanas.

La aplicación debe permitir:

• Crear el engagement y definir su alcance.
• Seleccionar decisiones o casos de uso.
• Invitar stakeholders y asignar actividades.
• Utilizar un banco configurable de preguntas.
• Aplicar lógica condicional.
• Registrar notas de entrevistas.
• Solicitar aclaraciones.
• Cargar documentos PDF, Word y Excel.
• Asociar evidencia con preguntas, hallazgos u oportunidades.
• Registrar supuestos, vacíos, contradicciones y confianza.
• Controlar el estado y progreso.

No se requieren videoconferencias, grabación de reuniones ni integración con calendarios.

4. Motor de reglas, análisis y priorización

El cliente proporcionará la metodología, preguntas, fórmulas y criterios. El desarrollador deberá convertirlos en una solución configurable y mantenible.

El sistema debe soportar:

• Dimensiones y niveles de madurez.
• Scoring e identificación de brechas.
• Formulación de oportunidades.
• Mecanismos de generación de valor.
• Escenarios bajo, base y alto.
• Cálculos de ROI y payback.
• Criterios, pesos y reglas de exclusión.
• Priorización de hasta cinco oportunidades.
• Dependencias y roadmap inicial.
• Supuestos y niveles de confianza.

Los cálculos y el scoring deben ser determinísticos, versionados y trazables. Los mismos inputs, reglas y versiones deben producir el mismo resultado. La IA no debe inventar cifras ni reemplazar las fórmulas.

5. Integración de inteligencia artificial

Se utilizará una API de IA para resumir y clasificar información, relacionar respuestas de varios stakeholders, detectar vacíos o contradicciones, preparar preguntas de aclaración y crear borradores de oportunidades, explicaciones y narrativas ejecutivas.

Los outputs deben ser estructurados, editables y vinculados con la evidencia. El equipo interno debe poder aprobarlos, rechazarlos o ajustarlos antes de compartirlos.

La solución debe registrar prompts, modelo utilizado, fuentes, confianza, resultados y cambios humanos, además de controlar errores, consumo y costos de API. Las credenciales permanecerán protegidas en el backend y la información de clientes no podrá utilizarse para entrenamiento.

6. Panel administrativo

El equipo interno debe poder administrar:

• Usuarios, organizaciones y engagements.
• Preguntas, respuestas y lógica condicional.
• Contenidos en español e inglés.
• Madurez, scoring, pesos y thresholds.
• Fórmulas y parámetros de valor.
• Catálogo de casos de uso.
• Criterios de priorización.
• Prompts y versiones.
• Textos de resultados y reportes.
• Ajustes manuales, notificaciones, errores y consumo de APIs.

Los cambios de configuración deben conservar fecha, versión y responsable.

7. Resultados y reporte ejecutivo

La aplicación debe generar una vista ejecutiva y un reporte descargable en PDF con:

• Perfil de madurez y principales brechas.
• Mapa de oportunidades.
• Cinco oportunidades priorizadas.
• Business cases de alto nivel.
• Supuestos y nivel de confianza.
• Roadmap inicial.
• Recomendación y siguientes decisiones.

El reporte se generará en español o inglés, utilizará la identidad visual suministrada y requerirá aprobación interna antes de quedar disponible para el cliente.

REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS Y DE SEGURIDAD

• Arquitectura multiempresa con separación segura de datos.
• Acceso basado en roles.
• Cifrado en tránsito y almacenamiento.
• Backups y recuperación.
• Registro de errores y actividad.
• Exportación y eliminación de información.
• Ambientes de desarrollo, pruebas y producción.
• Aplicación privada desktop-first y diagnóstico adaptable a móvil.
• APIs y credenciales protegidas.
• Código y componentes documentados.
• Dependencias, plugins y licencias identificados.

El MVP tendrá inicialmente un uso controlado. No necesita infraestructura masiva, pero la arquitectura no debe impedir su evolución.

ARQUITECTURA PROPUESTA

El candidato deberá explicar:

• Stack, base de datos y hosting.
• Procesos ejecutados en el backend.
• Integración con IA y documentos.
• Generación de reportes.
• Seguridad entre organizaciones.
• Versionamiento de reglas y cálculos.
• Escalabilidad y mantenimiento.
• Costos mensuales de infraestructura, licencias y APIs.
• Riesgos de dependencia tecnológica.
• Forma de transferir la solución al cliente.

La plataforma no se seleccionará solamente por velocidad. También se evaluarán mantenibilidad, seguridad, flexibilidad y costo total de propiedad.

ENTREGABLES

1. Discovery y especificación funcional definitiva.
2. Arquitectura, modelo de datos y flujos.
3. Wireframes y diseño responsive.
4. MVP funcional en ambiente de pruebas.
5. Integraciones de IA, correo y almacenamiento.
6. Pruebas funcionales y soporte para User Acceptance Testing.
7. Correcciones y despliegue en producción.
8. Código, configuración y activos en cuentas del cliente.
9. Documentación técnica y administrativa.
10. Transferencia de conocimiento.
11. Garantía mínima de treinta días para errores.
12. Cotización separada de mantenimiento y evoluciones.

FUERA DEL ALCANCE INICIAL

Página corporativa, aplicación móvil nativa, pagos, integración completa con CRM, gestión de proyectos posteriores, videollamadas, colaboración simultánea, entrenamiento de un modelo propio, OCR avanzado y análisis autónomo de modelos complejos de Excel.

INFORMACIÓN PROPORCIONADA POR EL CLIENTE

El cliente entregará metodología, preguntas iniciales, dimensiones de madurez, fórmulas, criterios de comparación, catálogo de casos de uso, prompts, ejemplos de outputs, contenidos bilingües, identidad visual y acceso a un experto de negocio.

CONFIDENCIALIDAD Y PROPIEDAD

La metodología detallada, preguntas, fórmulas, prompts y templates se compartirán únicamente con candidatos preseleccionados bajo acuerdo de confidencialidad.

La solución, código, configuración, diseños, datos y activos serán propiedad del cliente. El trabajo deberá realizarse en cuentas controladas por el cliente o transferirse completamente antes del cierre. No se permitirá reutilizar o comercializar la metodología ni los componentes específicos del producto.

CONTENIDO OBLIGATORIO DE LA OFERTA

La propuesta debe incluir:

1. Experiencia y ejemplos verificables de Web Apps B2B.
2. Experiencia integrando IA mediante APIs.
3. Arquitectura recomendada y justificación.
4. Equipo y responsabilidad de cada participante.
5. Plan, tiempo y precio por hitos.
6. Precio separado para discovery.
7. Supuestos y exclusiones.
8. Costos mensuales estimados.
9. Estrategia de pruebas, seguridad y respaldo.
10. Soporte posterior al lanzamiento.
11. Riesgos o aspectos que requieren mayor definición.
12. Disponibilidad para entrevista y confidencialidad.

Responder también:

• ¿Cómo implementaría un motor configurable, versionado y trazable?
• ¿Cómo separaría cálculos determinísticos y análisis de IA?
• ¿Cómo impediría el acceso cruzado entre organizaciones?
• ¿Cómo manejaría la revisión humana y el historial de cambios?
• ¿Cuál considera que es la parte más riesgosa?

Se valorará una estimación realista y sustentada. La oferta debe separar el precio de discovery del costo estimado de construcción del MVP.

# Scope of Work – Cross-Platform Fitness Mobile App

## 1. Project Overview

Develop a modern, responsive, and user-friendly fitness mobile application for **Android and iOS** using a cross-platform technology such as **React Native or Flutter**.

The application will help users track workouts, follow fitness plans, monitor progress, and manage their overall fitness activities from a single platform.

* Progress overview

* Exercise library with images/videos

* Beginner, intermediate, and advanced workouts
* Workout plans/routines
* Exercise instructions
* Sets, reps, weight, and rest timer

## 5. Fitness Goals & Progress Tracking

* Set personal fitness goals
* Weight tracking
* Body measurements
* Workout statistics
* Calories burned tracking
* Weekly/monthly progress
* Charts and visual progress reports

## 6. Nutrition Module

* Daily calorie tracking
* Food/meal logging
* Basic nutrition information
* Meal plans

## 7. Notifications & Reminders

* Workout reminders
* Meal reminders
* Goal reminders
* Progress notifications
* Push notifications
* Custom notification preferences

## 8. Subscription & Payment

If required:

* Free and premium plans
* Monthly/yearly subscriptions
* In-app purchase integration
* Subscription management
* Premium workout/nutrition content

## 9. Admin Panel

A web-based admin dashboard will be provided to manage:

* Users
* Exercises
* Workout programs
* Categories
* Nutrition/meal data
* Subscription plans
* Notifications
* User activity and basic analytics
* Content management

## 10. Backend & API

* Secure REST API/backend development
* Database design and implementation
* User authentication and authorization
* Workout and progress data management
* Push notification services
* Payment/subscription APIs
* Admin APIs
* Secure data handling

## 11. Third-Party Integrations

Depending on project requirements:

* Google/Apple authentication
* Firebase Cloud Messaging
* Apple Health
* Google Fit / Health Connect
* Payment gateways
* Analytics
* Cloud storage for images/videos

## 12. UI/UX

* Modern fitness-focused UI
* Responsive layouts for different mobile screen sizes
* Easy navigation
* Consistent design system
* Interactive charts and progress indicators
* Light/dark mode if required

## 13. Testing & Deployment

* Functional testing
* API testing
* Cross-device testing
* Performance testing
* Bug fixing
* Android build generation
* iOS build generation
* App Store and Google Play deployment assistance

## 14. Deliverables

* Android mobile application
* iOS mobile application
* Backend/API
* Database
* Admin panel
* Source code
* UI implementation
* Third-party integrations
* Production deployment
* Basic technical documentation

## 15. Out of Scope

Unless specifically agreed, the following are excluded:

* AI-based personal trainer
* Live trainer/video calling
* Wearable hardware development
* Advanced medical/health diagnostics
* Custom hardware integrations
* Complex AI nutrition recommendations
* Multi-vendor marketplace functionality
* Ongoing maintenance after the agreed support period

## Recommended Technology Stack

**Mobile:** React Native / Flutter
**Backend:** Node.js / Laravel
**Database:** PostgreSQL / MySQL / MongoDB
**Authentication & Notifications:** Firebase
**Admin Panel:** React / Next.js
**Cloud:** AWS / Firebase / similar cloud platform

### Estimated Development Phases

1. UI/UX Design
2. Mobile App Development
3. Backend & Database Development
4. Admin Panel
5. Third-Party Integrations
6. Testing & QA
7. Deployment
8. Post-launch bug-fix/support period

Clean
Minimal
Modern
Premium
Easy to understand
Beginner-friendly
Visually satisfying
Fully functional
Branded around Warm Wisdom

Warm cream/beige backgrounds
Dark green/forest green
Subtle gold/brown accents
Clean typography
Minimal borders
Subtle botanical/nature-inspired elements where appropriate

The design should feel consistent with the Warm Wisdom brand.

Core Functionality

The tracker should allow the user to track multiple habits every day throughout the month.

Exercise
Reading
Meditation
Drinking water
Sleeping early
Studying
Journaling
Coding
Custom habits

Daily Tracking

Daily completion

Weekly completion
Monthly completion
Overall progress
Remaining goals
Best-performing habits
Weakest habits

The calculations should update automatically when the user changes their checkboxes/status.
Dynamic Calendar

Month: August

The system should correctly handle:

28-day months

Different starting weekdays

Overall Progress

67%

Daily performance

Please clearly explain any differences between the two versions.

WARM WISDOM

Build consistency. One day at a time.

I need a Python developer to craft a self-contained scraper inside a lightweight Django app for our client’s own website. Phase 1 is all about reliability and clarity, not bells and whistles.

Scope of work
• Create a fresh Django project with a single command (e.g., python manage.py scrape) that navigates the distributed pages of the site, gathers the required text-based content, and captures any embedded timestamps or IDs that help with later analysis.

items.title: Shopify Dropship Automation SaaS Build
items.description:
E-Store Manager

E-Store Manager is a multi-tenant Shopify app designed to automate product discovery, fulfillment, marketing, and customer service for dropshipping stores operating on an Amazon FBA-style fulfillment model — where products are sold on the merchant’s own Shopify storefront but fulfilled and shipped through Amazon’s fulfillment network rather than traditional slow-ship dropshipping.

What it does

Product Discovery
A discovery engine identifies best-selling products within a given niche — surfacing what’s already proven to sell well, rather than speculative bulk-buy bets. It pulls data from:

	•	CJdropshipping — product search, pricing, order creation, and tracking via their API

	•	AutoDS — automated product search/import, with one-way push to Shopify

	•	DSers — AliExpress-sourced catalog, synced through the DSers UI into Shopify

Products are ranked using signals like sales velocity/demand, margin, trend momentum (Google Trends, public TikTok signals), customer rating, and market saturation within the niche — without scraping restricted sources like Amazon bestseller pages. The goal is to tell the merchant “these are the winning products in your niche right now,” so they can decide which to add to their store.

Product Import & Sync
Once a merchant selects products from the discovery results, they’re imported into their Shopify store via the Shopify Admin API, with supplier metadata (source, cost, shipping time) tagged for later routing.

Fulfillment — Amazon FBA Focused
Instead of routing every order back to the original supplier for one-off shipping, the app treats Amazon as the primary fulfillment warehouse.

	•	Merchant-owned inventory that has been shipped into Amazon’s warehouses is fulfilled via the Amazon SP-API (Multi-Channel Fulfillment / MCF) when a Shopify order comes in — Amazon picks, packs, and ships the order using its own logistics network, even though the sale happened on Shopify.

	•	Products not yet stocked at Amazon can fall back to standard supplier-side fulfillment via CJdropshipping/AutoDS/DSers.

	•	The routing layer decides per-order which path to use based on whether FBA stock exists for that SKU.

Marketing
AI-generated marketing copy (product descriptions, ad copy, social posts) is drafted for each product, but always requires human approval before publishing — no autonomous posting.

Customer Service
AI-drafted responses to common customer inquiries (order status, returns, product questions — including FBA-specific questions like Amazon-handled shipping/tracking), again with a human-in-the-loop review step rather than fully autonomous replies.

Multi-Tenancy
The app is built to manage multiple independent Shopify stores from a single instance, with per-store OAuth sessions, isolated data, and separate supplier/FBA inventory configurations for each tenant.

How it works (architecture)

	1. 	Shopify OAuth — each store installs the app and authorizes access; sessions and tokens are stored per-tenant.

	2. 	Discovery Engine — periodically queries supplier APIs and market-signal sources, identifies top-selling products per niche, scores them, and stores candidates for merchant review.

	3. 	Import Layer — approved products are written to Shopify via the Admin API, with supplier source and FBA-stock status tagged in metadata.

	4. 	Order/Fulfillment Webhooks — Shopify order events trigger routing logic: if the SKU has FBA inventory, the order is dispatched to Amazon via SP-API/MCF; otherwise it falls back to supplier dropship fulfillment.

	5. 	Marketing & CS Modules — generate drafts, hold them in a review queue, and only push/send after merchant approval.

	6. 	Data Layer — a relational schema tracks stores, sessions, discovered products (with niche/bestseller signals), imported products, FBA inventory levels, orders, line items, and fulfillment status/source, enabling reporting and reconciliation across tenants.

Skills: PHP, Python, iPhone, Amazon Web Services, Shopify, Dropshipping, API Development, SaaS Development

items.title: First-Person Mars Geological Sampling Game
items.description:
I’m building a small, first-person experience that places the player in the boots of a field geologist on Mars. The core loop is simple: roam a realistic Martian terrain, collect rock and soil samples, run quick in-game analyses, and decide which specimens are scientifically valuable and which are junk. Because exploration is the main pillar, I need expansive but navigable landscapes, believable mineral formations, and subtle environmental storytelling that rewards thorough observation.

To keep immersion high, the art direction must stay photo-real: authentic color palettes, physically based materials, and accurate lighting that sells the thin atmosphere and harsh sunlight. While there is no combat or arcade-style action, small interactive puzzles—identifying strata, operating sampling equipment, powering remote drones—will break up the traversal and reinforce the theme.

The aesthetic should reflect futuristic space visuals with machinery repurposed for brutal rock movement in a post-apocalyptic setting. Think along the lines of an Atreides theme from Dune.

Here’s what I’d like delivered in the first milestone:  
• A playable grey-box level (Unreal or Unity, your choice) in first-person, featuring a kilometre-wide terrain chunk, basic movement, and a working sampling tool.  
• Three rock types with placeholder textures and a simple “lab scanner” UI that marks each specimen as correct or incorrect based on hidden properties.  
• Clean, commented project files so mechanics can be expanded later.

If you love environmental design, geology-flavoured game mechanics, and realistic shaders, let’s talk about bringing the Red Planet to life.

items.title: Hydro Excavation Mobile Game
items.description:
I’m ready to turn my hydro-excavation concept into a fully playable mobile title for iOS and Android. The player will operate a vacuum truck and high-pressure water lance, carefully uncovering buried cables and pipes without damaging them. I need realistic visuals—wet soil, pressurised water, mud flow, and metallic utilities should all look and behave convincingly on touch screens.

Core gameplay combines three pillars:  
• Time-based missions that reward fast yet careful digging.  
• Puzzle-style decision making—choose where to probe, adjust water pressure, brace trenches, and route suction hoses.  
• Exploration and discovery across procedurally arranged job sites, from quiet suburbs to busy industrial corridors.

Please build with a mobile-friendly engine such as Unity or Unreal, implementing real-time erosion, particle effects, and physics that still run smoothly on mid-range phones. I’ll need:

1. A tutorial yard teaching nozzle control and utility detection.  
2. At least two mission maps featuring varied soil layers and randomly placed electrical, fibre, and gas lines.  
3. UI/UX that works in portrait and landscape, with touch controls for water flow, suction, and camera pan/zoom.  
4. Optimised APK and IPA builds plus full documented source so I can add new levels later.

If you’ve tackled realistic physics, fluid simulation, or construction-themed games on mobile, I’d love to see your work. Let’s dig in!

Skills: Mobile App Development, Android, 3D Modelling, Unity 3D, Physics, Game Development, Unreal Engine, Unity

items.title: Product Inventory Reporting Software
items.description:
I need a straightforward piece of software that lets me store and maintain my product inventory, then quickly generate clear, well-formatted reports from that data. The core requirement is solid data management: products must be added, edited, and removed with full audit history, and every change should instantly reflect in the reporting module.

Key functionality  
• Inventory database – items, quantities, SKUs, categories, suppliers, and cost/price fields.  
• Reporting engine – on-demand and scheduled export (PDF and CSV) covering stock on hand, low-stock alerts, and valuation summaries.  

I’m flexible on tech stack; pick the language, framework, or platform you are most productive with, provided the final deliverable runs reliably on a standard Windows or browser-based environment and can be handed over with source code and setup instructions.

Acceptance criteria  
1. Add/edit/delete product screens work without errors.  
2. Reports match sample layouts I’ll supply and can be regenerated after each inventory change.  
3. Clean, well-commented code and a short README for deployment.

If you’ve built similar data-driven tools or inventory modules before, include a brief note or link in your bid so I can review. I’m ready to start as soon as I find the right fit.

Skills: PHP, C# Programming, Software Architecture, Microsoft Access, MySQL, Software Development, Database Management, Data Management

items.title: Laravel Developer Needed: Web and Mobile Development
items.description:
# Experienced PHP Laravel Developer Required – Existing Website + Mobile App

We are looking for an **experienced PHP Laravel developer based specifically in Jaipur, Rajasthan** to work on our existing website and mobile application project.

**Strong hands-on experience with PHP and Laravel is mandatory.** We are specifically looking for a developer or development team **located in Jaipur, Rajasthan**, as we prefer to work with someone who is available for regular communication and, when required, in-person discussions/meetings.

The developer will be responsible for fixing existing issues, developing new features, optimizing the website, and providing ongoing technical support after the initial development is completed.

##  Location Requirement – Jaipur, Rajasthan

**Candidates must be based in Jaipur, Rajasthan.**

Preference will be given to developers/teams who:

* Are currently based in **Jaipur, Rajasthan**
* Can communicate regularly and coordinate with our team
* Are available for **in-person meetings in Jaipur when required**
* Are interested in a **long-term working relationship**
* Have their own development setup/team in Jaipur

**Please apply only if you are currently based in Jaipur, Rajasthan.**

## Project Requirements

### 1. Bug Fixes & Existing Website Maintenance

* Identify and fix functionality-related bugs and errors.
* Debug existing Laravel/PHP code.
* Resolve database, API, backend, and frontend-related issues where required.
* Ensure existing features work reliably without breaking other functionality.

### 2. Feature Development

* Develop and integrate new features according to our requirements.
* Modify and improve existing modules.
* Work with existing database structures and APIs.
* Write clean, maintainable, and scalable Laravel/PHP code.

### 3. Performance Optimization

* Improve overall website speed and performance.
* Optimize Laravel/PHP code and database queries.
* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks.
* Follow proper coding, security, and optimization best practices.

### 4. Mobile Application Development

In addition to the website, **we also want to develop a mobile application based on the existing website/system**.

The selected developer/team should either:

items.title: ROS 2 AMR – Motor, LiDAR SLAM & Autonomous Navigation Integration
items.description:
I have a differential-drive autonomous mobile robot running ROS 2 and need the whole motion stack stitched together around a pair of Nidec motors driven by an FBL2360TE controller. Your first task will be bringing that controller and its quadrature encoders cleanly into ROS 2 so accurate wheel odometry publishes through TF.

The biggest hurdle I anticipate is Nav2 autonomous navigation; path planning, obstacle avoidance and localization must run smoothly on-board with minimal CPU overhead. • ROS 2 nodes or launch files that interface the FBL2360TE, publish /cmd_vel and encoder odometry, and broadcast TF frames.  
• SLAM Toolbox configuration producing a consistent map in our warehouse environment.  
• Fully configured Nav2 stack demonstrating live localization, global & local path planning and dynamic obstacle avoidance.  
• Step-by-step test procedure and final real-world validation video or bag files showing a complete autonomous run.  

Hands-on experience with ROS 2, TF2, encoder math, Nav2 tuning and, ideally, the Nidec/FBL2360TE hardware will let you move quickly. If that sounds like your skill set, let’s start building.

items.title: Personalized AI-based Study Scheduler
items.description:
StudyPilot – AI Study Planner MVP

I am looking for a developer to build a simple mobile-friendly web app/PWA called StudyPilot.

The purpose of the app is to help students create personalized study schedules based on their exam date, subjects, chapters, available study hours, and their confidence level in each topic.

This is an MVP, so the priority is functionality and a clean user experience rather than advanced features.

Core features:

1. User can create an exam by entering the exam name, exam date, and available daily study hours.

2. User can add subjects such as Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, etc.

3. User can add chapters/topics under each subject.

4. User can mark each topic as Weak, Okay, or Strong.

5. The system generates a personalized study plan based on the exam date, available study time, number of topics, and topic priority.

6. Users can view their tasks for each day, including subject, topic, and estimated study time.

7. Users can mark tasks as completed.

8. If a user does not complete a task, they should be able to mark it as unfinished and the system should move it to a later available day.

9. A simple progress dashboard should show overall progress and progress by subject.

10. A basic AI assistant can be included for study-related requests such as explaining topics, generating short quizzes, and helping adjust the study schedule.

The app should be mobile responsive and preferably built as a PWA/web app rather than a native Android/iOS application.

The design should be modern, minimal, clean, and student-friendly.

For the MVP, I do not need payment systems, subscriptions, social features, leaderboards, advanced analytics, or a native mobile application.

Budget: ₹5,000

I already have the complete concept and feature requirements. I am looking for someone who can build a functional MVP within this budget.

Please send:

* Examples of similar web/PWA projects you have built
* Your proposed technology stack

* Estimated delivery time
* Confirmation that the source code/project files will be provided after completion

Skills: JavaScript, Mobile App Development, HTML, Web Development, AI Chatbot, AI Model Development, AI Content Creation, AI Development

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Forex trading, MetaTrader 5, and executing trades accurately based on provided instructions. This role requires someone reliable, detail-oriented, and able to actively monitor Telegram communications during UK trading hours.

This is a 1-month project consisting of a 1-week paid trial period, followed by 3 weeks of active trading support for a successful candidate.

Project Schedule

Week 1 – Trial Period

The first week will be used to assess:

* Understanding of Forex signals
* Accuracy of MT5 trade execution
* Speed of response to new signals
* Ability to follow trading instructions and risk rules
* Reliability and communication

After successful completion of the trial period, the project will continue for the remaining 3 weeks.

Weeks 2–4 – Active Trading Support

The assistant will actively monitor Telegram signals and execute trades on MT5 according to the provided instructions.

Working Hours

UK Time: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

During these hours, the assistant must:

* Be available and actively monitoring Telegram channels
* Respond promptly when trading signals are received
* Execute trades accurately without unnecessary delays
* Provide updates on completed trade entries and management

Responsibilities

* Monitor Telegram trading signal channels
* Review and interpret trading instructions
* Execute trades on MetaTrader 5 accurately
* Enter and manage:
    * Market orders
    * Pending orders
    * Stop Loss levels
    * Take Profit levels
    * Trade modifications when instructed
* Follow predefined lot size and risk management rules
* Monitor open positions and provide updates
* Maintain a record of executed trades
* Report any issues with MT5, broker connection, or trade execution

Required Skills & Experience

Applicants must have:

* Previous experience using MetaTrader 5
* Practical Forex trading experience
* Experience following trading signals
* Understanding of Forex terminology, including:
    * Currency pairs
    * Pips
    * Lot sizes
    * Spread
    * Entry points
    * Stop Loss and Take Profit
    * Market and pending orders
* Strong attention to detail
* Reliable internet connection
* Ability to work UK hours consistently

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in the following will be preferred:

* Forex trading assistant roles
* Telegram signal execution
* MT5 trade copier systems
* MQL5 Expert Advisors or trading automation

Application Requirements

Please include the following in your application:

1. Your Forex trading experience
2. How many years you have used MetaTrader 5
3. Previous experience handling Telegram trading signals
4. Your availability during UK working hours
5. Your proposed price for the 1-month project

This role requires accuracy, discipline, and reliability. Please only apply if you have genuine MT5 and Forex trading experience.

Our study aims to determine whether the extraction method (aqueous and ethanolic) and extract concentration (25%, 50%, 75%, and 100%) affect the antifungal activity of snake plant leaf extract against Saccharomyces cerevisiae. The plant leaves will undergo preparation and extraction, while the resulting extracts will be evaluated through an appropriate laboratory antifungal susceptibility assay.

We are seeking the assistance of a qualified microbiologist to supervise and provide technical guidance during the microbiological portion of the study. Specifically, we need assistance in verifying the suitability of the S. cerevisiae culture, preparing and standardizing the fungal inoculum, selecting the appropriate culture medium and antifungal testing procedure, establishing suitable controls, ensuring proper aseptic technique and laboratory safety, and interpreting the resulting inhibition data. All microbiological procedures involving the live culture will be conducted under the supervision of the microbiologist and according to the partner laboratory's established protocols.

The expected output of the project is a comparative evaluation of the antifungal activity of the different snake plant extracts based on their measured zones of inhibition, allowing us to determine whether extraction method and concentration influence the observed antifungal activity.

Assistance We Are Looking For

Technical supervision of the microbiological procedures
Verification of Saccharomyces cerevisiae culture
Guidance on appropriate fungal culture medium and assay
Preparation/standardization of the fungal inoculum
Guidance on appropriate positive and negative controls
Supervision of the antifungal assay
Proper measurement and recording of inhibition zones
Guidance on laboratory safety, aseptic technique, and waste disposal
Assistance in interpreting the microbiological results

items.title: Indian Companies B2B Leads & Data Mining
items.description:
Project Title: B2B Contact Enrichment & Lead Mining: 2,000 Indian Companies
Project Type: Fixed Price
Budget: INR 7000 to INR 11000
Skills to Tag: Lead Generation, Web Scraping, Data Mining, B2B Leads, Web Search
Project Overview:
We are looking for a B2B Data profiling &Scraping Specialist to get data of 2,000 Indian companies with accurate details.
Key Responsibilities & Required Data Fields:
For each of the 2,000 companies provided in an Excel sheet, you will mine and populate:
Official Company Website URL , city
Contact 1: Full Name, Exact Designation (e.g. Co-Founder, Founder, or C-Level), LinkedIn URL, Verified Direct Email, and Mobile Number, city
Contact 2: Full Name, Exact Designation (e.g Co-Founder, Founder, or C-Level), LinkedIn URL, Verified Direct Email, and Mobile Number , city
Quality & Acceptance Criteria:
Data Completeness: min 2 verified executive profile entries per company (where available).
Direct Contacts Only: Person-specific work emails only (e.g., name @company.com) ). Generic info@ or contact@ will not be considered & will be rejected.
Email Verification: All emails must be pre-verified using email bounce tools before submitting to us (report to be shared that you have run this and its result)
Mobile Numbers: Direct mobile numbers preferred over standard corporate board lines.
Applicants must agree to complete a 20-company sample batch to demonstrate data accuracy before the full project is awarded. Please state all the data tools you shall use  in your proposal response.

Skills: Data Entry, Excel, Web Scraping, Web Search, Data Mining, Market Research, Data Analysis, Lead Generation, B2B Marketing, Data Collection

I now want players to download a single mod (or plugin) that faithfully re-enacts every one of those events, in the exact order and at the exact timestamps that happened live, on any 26.2 Minecraft instance.

Acceptance criteria

items.title: Estrategia y Ejecución de Google Ads para Venta de Servicios
items.description:
Busco un/a freelancer con experiencia en Google Ads de Búsqueda y campañas orientadas a la venta de servicios profesionales.

El proyecto es para Capital Digital, una marca de estrategia, posicionamiento y comunicación digital. El objetivo no es generar alcance, likes ni tráfico sin propósito: buscamos vender uno de nuestros servicios mediante una campaña bien estructurada y medible.

No buscamos simplemente activar anuncios o promocionar publicaciones. La idea es crear un embudo de captación comercial completo, dirigido a personas o empresas con una necesidad activa: búsqueda en Google, anuncio relevante, landing page específica, formulario o canal de contacto, seguimiento y medición de resultados. Estamos abiertos a escucharte en caso de que trabajes con otras herramientas de promoción, como PPC.

La primera fase se trabajará únicamente con Google Ads de Búsqueda. Por el momento no se contempla Meta Ads, campañas Display, pop-ups, compra de clics ni tráfico masivo de baja calidad.

El sitio web y CRM están alojados en GoHighLevel. Podemos construir internamente las landing pages, formularios, páginas de agradecimiento, automatizaciones y pipeline de seguimiento necesarios. Sin embargo, buscamos a alguien que pueda aportar criterio estratégico para definir qué embudo necesitamos y qué elementos deben estar listos antes de invertir en la campaña.

Qué necesitamos principalmente:

* Recomendar cuál de nuestros servicios sería más conveniente promover primero, considerando intención de búsqueda, viabilidad comercial y posibilidad de venta.

* Proponer una estrategia inicial de Google Ads Search enfocada en generar oportunidades reales de venta.

* Investigar y seleccionar búsquedas y palabras clave con intención comercial, incluyendo negativas para evitar clics irrelevantes.

* Recomendar el enfoque de los anuncios, la oferta, el llamado a la acción y la estructura necesaria de la landing page.

* Configurar o supervisar la medición de acciones relevantes: envío de formulario, solicitud de información, clic a WhatsApp, reserva de una reunión u otra conversión acordada.

* Configurar y optimizar un piloto inicial de campaña, con un presupuesto limitado y previamente aprobado.

* Entregar reportes comprensibles sobre inversión, consultas, conversiones, calidad de oportunidades y recomendaciones.

Forma de trabajo esperada:

* Antes de activar inversión, requerimos una fase breve de análisis, recomendación y propuesta de implementación.

* Buscamos un piloto inicial de aproximadamente 21 a 30 días, sujeto a la recomendación del profesional.

* Capital Digital conservará la propiedad de la cuenta de Google Ads, dominio, sitio web, GoHighLevel/CRM, landing pages, datos, conversiones y facturación.

* El acceso se otorgará por invitación y con los permisos necesarios para trabajar; no se compartirán contraseñas ni datos de tarjetas.

* El método de pago y el presupuesto de la campaña serán gestionados por Capital Digital. Los honorarios profesionales se acordarán por separado.

* No se deberá aumentar el presupuesto, activar campañas adicionales ni abrir otros canales sin aprobación previa.

Al postular, por favor indica:

* Qué incluye exactamente tu servicio: estrategia, configuración, investigación de keywords, anuncios, medición, optimización y reportes.

* Qué información necesitarías de nuestra parte para comenzar.

* Qué recomendarías que construyamos nosotros en GoHighLevel y qué parte podrías implementar o supervisar tú.

* Tu propuesta de trabajo para el piloto, plazo estimado y entregables.

* Tus honorarios y qué tareas, si las hubiera, se cotizan por separado.

* Un ejemplo breve de una experiencia comparable con servicios profesionales, sin revelar información confidencial.

Valoramos especialmente propuestas transparentes, con un alcance realista, criterios de medición claros y recomendaciones basadas en intención de búsqueda y calidad comercial, no promesas genéricas de clics o resultados garantizados.

Skills: SEO, Google Adwords, Article Writing, Google Adsense, Search Engine Marketing, Conversion Rate Optimization, Digital Marketing, Marketing Strategy, Keyword Research, Lead Generation

We are seeking a senior systems architect or technical team to design, build, containerize, and operate the production backend for a real-time anomaly detection and threat-scoring platform for financial transactions.

This is not a proof-of-concept or an experimental sandbox. The final deliverable must be a fully hardened, real-time, fault-tolerant system built to run in live enterprise environments.

*System Overview*
The backend framework must:
- Ingest and process high-velocity transaction data continuously and without lag
- Detect irregular behavior using trained machine learning models, not static or hardcoded heuristics
- Publish live threat-assessment metrics through fast, low-latency endpoints
- Meet demanding throughput, response-time, and scaling requirements

Placeholder code, hardcoded logic, synthetic mock data, or simulated streaming endpoints will be treated as an automatic project default.

*Compensation & Milestone Schedule — GBP 2,300 Fixed, Paid in Two Stages*

_Stage 1 — GBP 2,185_
Released when the contract begins. Covers cloud resources, environment setup, and the initial core pipeline build.
Note: this payment is not delivery, review, or approval of the work. It does not waive any technical spec, throughput standard, or runtime target, and it does not limit legal recourse or clawback rights if the contract is breached.

Released only once:
- Production go-live is complete, end to end
- All microservices are active and reachable
- Latency and throughput metrics have been verified
- Full handover has taken place: source repos, model weights/artifacts, cloud/infra credentials, technical/architecture docs

If exit criteria aren't met, final payment is forfeited.

*What Needs to Get Built*
Leave out any piece below and the whole delivery counts as failed.

_Data Intake_
- Distributed streaming, running on Kafka and Spark Streaming
- Handles serious payload volume without falling behind, in real time
- Schema checks, cleanup, and validation baked into the pipeline itself

_Feature Engineering_
- One central place where computed features live
- Real-time streaming and offline batch computation running side by side

_Detection & Scoring_
- Anomaly detection that mixes statistical boundaries with recurrent LSTM models
- A weighted service that blends multiple models into one threat score
- Model inference that returns results in well under a second
- Fixed rule filters, hardcoded thresholds, or canned static responses won't cut it here.

_Making Predictions Explainable_
- SHAP-based explainability (or something equivalent)
- A plain-language reason attached to every score the model produces

_API & Application Layer_
- Built on FastAPI, organized into clean modules
- OAuth2/JWT handles enterprise authentication
- Structured to run as standalone microservices
- Complete OpenAPI/Swagger docs for anyone consuming the API downstream

_Infrastructure & DevOps_
- Kubernetes running across multiple nodes
- CI/CD automated end to end for builds and releases
- Grafana and Prometheus covering telemetry, logging, and observability
- Canary or blue-green deploys for safe rollouts
- A script that only runs locally, a docker-compose setup with no real scaling path, or anything that can't handle production traffic gets disqualified.

_Testing & QA_
- Load and concurrency testing pushed to peak volume
- A formal readiness check signed off before anything goes live

*Mandatory Performance Benchmarks*
The architecture must meet or exceed every one of these:
- Ingestion Rate: ≥ 50,000 events/sec
- Pipeline Latency: ≤ 2.0 seconds
- Feature Lookup: ≤ 50 milliseconds
- Model Precision: ≥ 90% true-positive anomaly rate
- Inference Compute Time: ≤ 80 milliseconds
- API Round-Trip Response: ≤ 400 milliseconds

Missing a single benchmark constitutes non-delivery.

*Uptime & Reliability*
99.5% uptime, tracked monthly. Usual carve-outs apply — scheduled maintenance, third-party vendor outages, force majeure, or unauthorized changes.

*Support Coverage*
Hours: 09:00–18:00 GMT/BST
- Sev 1 (everything's down): triage within 4 hrs, patched within 24 hrs
- Sev 2 (major functionality broken): triage within 8 hrs, patched within 48 hrs
- Sev 3 (small issue): triage within 1 business day, resolved within 5

*When Is This Actually Done?*
Sign-off happens only when, all at once:
- It's live and running in a real cloud environment
- Every listed component is up and checked
- The models are giving real predictions, not sample output
- Latency and throughput hold up under actual load
- CI/CD and monitoring are working
- Architecture docs and runbooks delivered

*Security, Governance & Regulatory Compliance*
Must follow safeguards aligned with ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, and applicable PCI-DSS standards. All pipelines must comply with UK/EU GDPR. Anonymized, non-attributable data may be used only where legally permitted.

*Default, Breach & Recourse*

*Liability Bounds*

This isn't a prototype or a portfolio piece — the end result needs to run live, under real load, in a real enterprise environment, with real money moving through it.

Transactions flow in continuously, get scored for risk in near-real-time by trained ML models, and surface actionable alerts through a fast, well-documented API — all while the whole stack stays observable, scalable, and secure.

We won't accept stubbed-out logic, hardcoded thresholds standing in for real models, mocked data streams, or anything that only works in a demo. If it can't survive production traffic, it doesn't count.

WHAT YOU'LL BE BUILDING

1. Ingestion Layer
- A distributed streaming pipeline (Kafka + Spark Streaming) that keeps pace with high transaction volume in real time, with no backlog buildup
- Validation, cleanup, and schema enforcement built directly into the pipeline, not bolted on after

2. Feature Store
- A single, centralized feature repository
- Streaming and batch feature computation running in parallel, kept consistent with each other

3. Detection & Scoring Engine
- Hybrid anomaly detection: statistical thresholds combined with a trained LSTM (recurrent) model — no static rule sets pretending to be ML
- An ensemble layer that blends model outputs into a single weighted threat score
- Sub-second inference, every time

4. Explainability Layer
- SHAP (or a comparable method) attached to every prediction
- A human-readable explanation accompanying each score, no black-box outputs

5. API Layer
- FastAPI, cleanly modularized by domain
- OAuth2/JWT for enterprise-grade auth
- Each major function deployable as its own microservice
- Full OpenAPI/Swagger documentation

6. Infrastructure
- Kubernetes, multi-node, production-configured
- Full CI/CD, no manual build/deploy steps
- Observability via Prometheus + Grafana (metrics, logs, alerting)
- Canary or blue-green rollout strategy
- Local-only setups or docker-compose without a real scaling path will not pass review

7. QA & Load Validation
- Load and concurrency testing at peak projected volume
- A formal go/no-go readiness review before anything touches production

PERFORMANCE BENCHMARKS (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

- Ingestion throughput: 50,000+ events/sec
- End-to-end pipeline latency: 2.0 seconds or less
- Feature lookup time: 50 ms or less
- Model precision (true positives): 90% or higher
- Inference compute time: 80 ms or less
- API round-trip response: 400 ms or less

Missing any one of these means the deliverable isn't accepted.

Uptime target: 99.5%, measured monthly (standard exclusions apply: scheduled maintenance, third-party outages, force majeure, unauthorized changes).

POST-LAUNCH SUPPORT

Coverage window: 09:00 to 18:00 GMT/BST

Sev 1 (full outage): triage in 4 hours, resolved in 24 hours
Sev 2 (major feature broken): triage in 8 hours, resolved in 48 hours
Sev 3 (minor issue): triage in 1 business day, resolved in 5 business days

COMPENSATION

Total: £2,300 fixed, paid in two milestones

Milestone 1: £2,100, released at contract start to cover environment setup, cloud resources, and initial pipeline development. This payment does not constitute approval, sign-off, or a waiver of any technical requirement. All specs, benchmarks, and runtime targets in this brief remain fully in force regardless.

Milestone 2 (final settlement): £200, released only after full production go-live, all services verified active and meeting every latency/throughput benchmark, and complete handover (source code, model artifacts, credentials, and documentation). If exit criteria aren't met, this final payment is forfeited.

DEFINITION OF DONE

All of the following, simultaneously, no partial credit:
- Live in a real cloud environment, not a staging sandbox
- Every component listed above deployed and verified
- Models producing genuine predictions on real data
- Benchmarks holding under actual load, not synthetic tests
- CI/CD and monitoring fully operational
- Documentation and runbooks delivered
- All credentials, repositories, and model files transferred

Acceptance is binary. "Nearly done," "beta," and "mostly working" submissions are not accepted, and there's no prorated payment for partially completed modules.

COMPLIANCE & SECURITY

Must align with ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, and applicable PCI-DSS standards. All data handling must comply with UK/EU GDPR; synthetic or anonymized data may only be used where legally appropriate.

IP, CONFIDENTIALITY & LEGAL TERMS

IP transfer: Upon final payment, all custom code, models, configs, and documentation transfer fully to the Employer. The developer retains rights to any pre-existing generic tooling, boilerplate, or reusable infrastructure scripts not built specifically for this project.

Confidentiality: Indefinite, for both parties, covering architecture, workflows, models, live data, secrets, and configs.

Breach: Failure to deliver a fully functioning, benchmark-compliant production system is treated as material breach, entitling the Employer to terminate and seek recovery of funds paid.

Suspension rights: The developer may pause work for unpaid invoices (30+ days), Employer breach of core terms, discovered misuse, or an urgent unpatched security risk.

Liability: Standard statutory limits apply; no limitation on liability for death or injury from negligence, fraud, or non-waivable statutory duties.

Force majeure: Standard carve-outs for events outside either party's control.

Communication: All binding communication must occur through Freelancer.com; off-platform agreements carry no contractual weight.

Governing law: England and Wales, exclusive jurisdiction.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- A demonstrated track record deploying high-availability distributed systems to production, not just prototypes
- Deep hands-on experience with high-throughput streaming architectures
- Experience containerizing and operating ML systems at scale
- Strong working knowledge of Kafka, Spark, Kubernetes, and FastAPI

TO APPLY, INCLUDE

items.title: # Job Application Support Specialist – Performance-Based Remote Project
items.description:
I’m looking for reliable and detail-oriented **Job Application Support Specialists** to help me apply for relevant professional opportunities across the U.S. job market.

My primary focus is **quality and results, not the number of applications submitted**.

### What You’ll Do

* Search for relevant U.S.-based job opportunities that match my background and target roles.
* Submit applications accurately using the resume and information I provide.
* Follow application instructions carefully and avoid duplicate or irrelevant applications.
* Keep a simple record of the positions you apply to.
* Focus on opportunities with a strong chance of moving forward in the hiring process.

### Payment Structure

This is a **performance-based project**.

**Payment: $10 for each qualified application that results in a genuine next-step request from the employer.**

A qualified next step may include:

* Recruiter or HR screening request
* Phone/video interview invitation
* Hiring manager interview
* Technical interview or assessment
* Other clear communication from the employer showing interest in continuing the hiring process

Simply submitting an application does **not** qualify for payment. The goal is to generate real employer interest and next-step opportunities.

### What I’m Looking For

The ideal person:

* Has experience with U.S. job boards and application processes
* Understands how to identify jobs that strongly match a candidate’s experience
* Is careful when completing application forms
* Can work independently and consistently
* Prioritizes application quality and relevance over volume
* Does not use false information or misrepresent qualifications

If you are interested, please send me a short introduction explaining your experience with job searching or application support.

For ongoing communication after we connect, I’m also available on Telegram: **@blackyak0705**

I’m interested in building a long-term working relationship with application specialists who can consistently generate strong results.

Skills: Data Entry, Recruitment, Bid Writing, Candidate Screening, Career Coaching

If you have experience drafting chargeback documentation, filing online fraud reports, or navigating GPay’s dispute system, your expertise will be invaluable. I will provide all evidence I have as soon as we start; the final package should be delivered in editable formats (Google Docs or Word) along with a brief walkthrough so I can act immediately.
